articles.title: Researchers Claim Two RCE Exploits That Bypass Telegram’s New Android Defenses
articles.text:
A malicious widget can bypass the security filter that Telegram added to its Android app last week and run code outside it, according to NebuSec, a security company.
Widgets are small interactive blocks that bots send inside chat messages, and their JavaScript runs on the user's phone. The researchers ran their demonstration on a Telegram test server, because only approved bots can send widgets on the live service now.
Bots could start sending widgets last week. Two days later, an account called V12 posted a video on X claiming that any Telegram message could now be used to execute remote code.
Telegram then put QuickJS, the small engine that runs widget JavaScript, into its own process on Android. It also added a seccomp filter, which can block or record the system calls that the process makes. Both changes appear in the source code it published for Telegram for Android 13.2.2 (7303).
NebuSec said in a technical analysis published earlier this week that its researchers got code running outside that filter in two separate ways. One uses a widget bug the filter does not cover, and the other chains a widget bug the filter does cover with a kernel bug.
In their video, a bot's Telegram widget on Android 13.2.2 (7303) bypasses the filter and opens the phone's calculator app, the researchers say.
Their write-up and their demonstration post on X do not say what the code could reach beyond that, such as the app's messages or the rest of the phone. They also do not say whether the user had to start the bot or tap the widget first.
The researchers are holding back the details for now. Their write-up names no CVE identifier and does not say whether the bugs were reported to the app's developers.
The widget documentation says widgets run in a sandbox, with rules such as no network access. Those rules live in the engine's own code, the researchers say. A single use-after-free or out-of-bounds write bug in QuickJS lets a script read and write the process's memory, and then the rules no longer protect anything.
The new filter names a few dozen system calls, such as ptrace, bpf, and mount, and lets every other call through. The filter's source code leaves ioctl unfiltered. The filter sits on top of Android's own limits on the engine process.
One process also runs every widget, so a hijacked widget from one bot shares memory with the widgets of every other bot, the researchers say.
In the published source code for Telegram for Android 13.2.2 (7303), that filter is set to an audit mode, The Hacker News found. In audit mode, it still blocks attempts to start new programs or processes, but it only records the other listed calls and lets them run.
A comment above the setting says how long that will last: "Audit until the logs from the devices say the engine never makes them." The published code does not show whether the version people install uses the same setting.
"Yes, currently, general bots aren't allowed to use widgets even in private chats," a contributor to the telegram-bot-api project wrote late last week in a bug report thread on GitHub. As of this week, no later message in the thread says which bots are still allowed or that the limit has been lifted.
The researchers' write-up lists no fixed version, and the published Android source code is no newer than 13.2.2 (7303) as of this week.
"No one could be hacked just by receiving a message," Pavel Durov, Telegram's chief executive, wrote late last week in a channel post. His post addressed reports of code execution through widgets in the Android and Windows apps, and came before the researchers' demonstration. He added that a user first had to start a third-party service, and that even that was fully patched on the server side.
The company had earlier said that the problem in V12's first demonstration was fixed and that the fix had reached all users.
Separately, the security vendor Kaspersky said late last week that it had detected suspected exploitation of a flaw in Telegram widgets when people visited some Telegram channels.
In that activity, a PowerShell script ran without the user noticing and downloaded and launched WebRAT, also known as Salat Stealer. The malware allows attackers to control the infected system and steal data from crypto wallets and Telegram accounts.
The vendor's malware warning does not identify the flaw or the Telegram version, does not report the number of victims, and does not link the activity to either demonstration. It advises not running widgets until a fix is released.

articles.title: 9 best iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch apps according to Apple — from ElevenReader to Cosmos
articles.text:
These are the best iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch apps of 2026 — according to Apple
An app for almost every need
- Apple has announced its App Store App of the Year finalists
- Three apps have been selected for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, respectively
- The winners will be announced in the coming weeks
Apple has just revealed its finalists for the best iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch apps of the year, so if you’ve been itching to install something new, there should be something here that’s worth a look.
On iPhone, the finalists include ElevenReader, which lets you listen to books, articles, PDFs, and any other text read in a natural-sounding AI voice.
There’s also (Not Boring) Camera, which simulates an old-school camera with customizable film-inspired looks, and Raylie, which tells you which side of a plane to sit on for the best view, and what sights to expect during your flight, such as sunsets and landmarks.
Over on iPad, the finalists include Cosmos, which lets you create and collaborate on an inspiring mood board. Then there’s Kiddopia, which includes over 3,000 games aimed at teaching children math, language, and more. Finally, there’s Mockup, which helps you sketch, wireframe, and prototype apps and websites.
Track your health, your stress, and the lunar calendar
For Apple Watch, the finalists include Bevel, which takes your health and fitness data and uses it to provide AI-powered, actionable insights.
There’s also Moonlitt, which includes a lunar calendar and will alert you about upcoming lunar events, such as eclipses. And there’s StressWatch, which is an AI-powered stress monitor, designed to show you your stress levels in real time, so you can change your habits to lessen your stress.
These nine apps were selected by global App Store editors for exemplifying “the very best in technical innovation, user experience, and design,” and while the winners will be announced in the coming weeks, any of these finalists should be worth a download if they sound appealing to you.

articles.title: GTA VI llegó con casi la nota máxima de la crítica y 16 millones de reservas estimadas
articles.text:
Grand Theft Auto VI, el videojuego más esperado de los últimos años, salió con una nota de 99 sobre 100 en Metacritic, el sitio que promedia reseñas de la prensa y con unas 16 millones de reservas, según estimaciones de la firma Sensor Tower.
Sensor Tower calculó que el juego ya había generado unos USD 1.540 millones en preventas Los analistas sostienen que podría superar los récords de ventas de GTA V, aunque ninguna de esas cifras fue confirmada por Rockstar Games, la desarrolladora.
El lanzamiento es escalonado: comenzó en Nueva Zelanda y avanza por zonas horarias, porque el juego se habilita a medianoche local del 19 de noviembre en todos los países.
Solo se vende para PlayStation 5 y para Xbox Series X y S. Las copias en caja traen un código de descarga y no un disco, según la BBC. La versión estándar cuesta USD 79,99 y la edición Ultimate, USD 99,99.
Dos calificaciones de GTA VI perfectas entre los críticos
Cuando terminó el plazo que Rockstar fijó para publicar reseñas, el puntaje de Metacritic salió de 114 críticas. IGN y GameSpot le pusieron 10 sobre 10, y Giant Bomb, cinco estrellas. El crítico de IGN Luke Reilly lo llamó el “videojuego más impresionante” que jugó.
GameSpot sí marcó un reparo: ciertas exigencias para avanzar interrumpen a veces el ritmo de la historia. Los críticos de The New York Times y Polygon destacaron la relación entre los dos protagonistas y la sátira de la sociedad estadounidense.
En The Verge, Andrew Webster dijo haber pasado casi 80 horas en Leonida, la versión ficticia de Florida donde transcurre el juego. Los protagonistas, Jason Duval y Lucia Caminos, son dos delincuentes de poca monta inspirados en la pareja de Bonnie y Clyde.
Webster señaló fallas: el combate sigue siendo torpe, la rueda de armas lo hizo equipar una linterna en lugar de una escopeta y vio errores menores, como un cadáver que se sacudía. Aun así, escribió que en una consola PS5 de lanzamiento el juego funcionó bien.
También, describió un sistema de puntos de control que reduce la repetición de escenas tras un fracaso, y la posibilidad de saltar una misión si el jugador falla demasiadas veces.
Lo que conviene saber antes de jugar GTA VI
GTA V vendió más de 230 millones de copias en 13 años, una cifra que explica la expectativa por la secuela, que además pasó por filtraciones y retrasos antes de llegar a las tiendas.
Quien reservó el juego digital puede descargarlo antes de la hora de salida. Polygon calculó que hacen falta 212 GB libres, más 1 GB para la primera actualización. El juego no permite partidas cruzadas entre PlayStation y Xbox y se limita a 30 cuadros por segundo en todas las consolas.
Es una experiencia para un solo jugador. GTA Online, el modo multijugador, funciona por separado, según Polygon.
Rockstar no ha anunciado una fecha para la versión de computadora.
Campañas de fraude por el lanzamiento de GTA VI
ESET advirtió sobre campañas de fraude y malware que aprovechan la expectativa por el lanzamiento de GTA VI, con sitios falsos que prometen accesos anticipados, versiones beta, descuentos o copias filtradas del videojuego.
Mario Miucci, investigador de Seguridad Informática de ESET Latinoamérica, afirmó que circularon supuestas imágenes del nuevo título en internet, pero que no existen pruebas de una versión auténtica y jugable que haya sido filtrada. “Lo que sí encontraron fueron campañas de malware diseñadas para aprovechar la demanda”.
Según la empresa de ciberseguridad, algunas campañas imitan la comunicación oficial de Rockstar Games, mientras otras ofrecen archivos que aparentan contener el juego completo. También detectaron tiendas online fraudulentas que comercializan productos inexistentes, como accesos anticipados, betas o reservas exclusivas.
La telemetría de ESET identificó miles de dominios vinculados con términos relacionados con GTA 6 o que suplantan la identidad de Rockstar. Parte de esos sitios reúne información de fanáticos, aunque otros pueden buscar obtener dinero, datos bancarios o credenciales de acceso de los usuarios.
“Los estafadores aprovechan esta familiaridad para hacer que las ofertas inexistentes parezcan creíbles”, explicó Miucci. Las páginas pueden utilizar logotipos, imágenes inspiradas en Vice City, autos de lujo y contenido generado con inteligencia artificial, junto con mensajes de urgencia o exclusividad.
Las recomendaciones para evitar estafas con GTA VI
ESET recomendó comprar el juego solo en comercios reconocidos y plataformas oficiales, sin ingresar desde enlaces de anuncios, redes sociales o correos electrónicos. También, aconsejó desconfiar de rebajas excesivas, contadores regresivos y mensajes que alertan sobre un supuesto stock limitado, ya que las copias digitales no se agotan.
Antes de pagar, conviene verificar los datos de contacto, las condiciones de venta y la política de devoluciones de la tienda. La compañía sugirió evitar criptomonedas, tarjetas de regalo u otros medios sin protección al comprador.
Rockstar anunció GTA VI para PlayStation 5 y Xbox Series X|S, sin beta, demo ni acceso anticipado. Por eso, una oferta para PC o dispositivos móviles debe considerarse una señal de alerta.

articles.title: GTA 6 Review Roundup: 99 on Metacritic and 118 Perfect Scores
articles.text:
Wednesday, November 18th 2026
GTA 6 Review Roundup: 99 on Metacritic and 118 Perfect Scores
After more than a decade of anticipation, Grand Theft Auto 6 finally launched on November 19th worldwide. Critics got early access to the game, and the reviews embargo lifted a day earlier. There was some concern about whether or not Grand Theft Auto 6 would be able to satisfy the enormous hype around it, but that has seemingly been put to rest. With a record-breaking Metascore of 99 at launch, made up of 118 perfect scores from critics, GTA 6 is one of the most well-received games of all time. On Metacritic, Rockstar's game has tied the original Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time with a score of 99. That means GTA 6 is tied for the highest Metascore ever, and ahead of every previous Rockstar game, including GTA 4 at 98.
The breakdown is also interesting to analyze. Out of 147 critic reviews for the PS5 version of GTA 6 on Metacritic, 118 are perfect scores, which made the 99 overall Metascore possible. Each one of those reviews is classed as positive, with zero mixed or negative reviews at the time of writing. The Xbox Series X version also sits at 99, though that's based on just 14 reviews. Plenty of big names handed out full marks to GTA 6, including IGN, GameSpot, Game Informer, Edge, Eurogamer, GamesRadar+, VGC, TechRadar Gaming, Destructoid, Push Square, Screen Rant, DualShockers, CGMagazine, ComicBook, Digital Spy, and Forbes.Some didn't go quite that far, such as GameStar with a 97 rating and Wccftech with 96, while the New York Times and IGN Japan both came in at 90 on the Metacritic scale. The lowest score we saw was ScreenHub's at 80, and the reviewer explains it by saying that the game drags on for quite a bit before it finally lets loose. However, that is an outlier, and the overall response to the game online has been extremely positive. GTA 6 has launched on the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, but PC players are still waiting for their turn, and it looks like they will have to wait for a few more months at least. Also, readers should remember that these are just critic scores, and audiences will form their own opinions in the coming days.

articles.title: GTA 6 : Free muscle son réseau pour faire face au lancement
articles.text:
Le lancement de la décennie dans le jeu vidéo, GTA 6, a lieu ce soir. Et pour y faire face, Free a mis les moyens !
Même si vous n'êtes pas un gamer, vous n'être sûrement pas passé à côté de cette nouvelle : GTA 6 va sortir officiellement ce soir à minuit, en France. Une sortie extrêmement attendue, puisque l'on dénombre, à quelques heures de ce lancement, un volume de précommandes numériques de près de 16 millions - et c'est sans compter toutes les précommandes en version boîte. Autant dire qu'il va y avoir des téléchargements massifs, que vont devoir gérer les opérateurs des télécommunications.
Free annonce avoir renforcé sa bande passante en prévision du lancement de GTA 6
À partir de ce soir, à minuit, ceux qui veulent jouer à GTA VI vont télécharger près de 212 Go de données. Et vu la popularité folle de ce jeu vidéo, sûrement déjà celui de la décennie, Free a annoncé avoir renforcé sa bande passante.
Des équipes spécifiques sont par ailleurs mobilisées pour l'occasion. L'objectif est de permettre le téléchargement sans souci de tous ceux qui le souhaitent, sans pour autant gêner les autres utilisateurs du réseau.
Un gel du réseau programmé pour les 18 et 19 novembre
Il faut dire que l'on a déjà un exemple avec Orange, qui a enregistré quelque 150 000 prétéléchargements depuis leur ouverture, le 10 novembre. Résultat, le trafic a été doublé par rapport à ce qui est habituellement observable. Le leader français du secteur a pour autant affirmé avoir réussi à gérer sans incident ce trafic exceptionnel.
Du côté de chez Free, selon nos confrères de Frandroid, on a aussi décidé exceptionnellement d'un gel du réseau ce 18 novembre ainsi que le 19 novembre. L'idée est de ne pas programmer d'intervention technique non urgente ou d'opérations de maintenance, qui sont autant de possibilités de créer une panne du fait d'une manipulation. De quoi tenir le choc ce soir ?

articles.title: Your Proton VPN's iPhone app has just changed its look — here's all you need to know
articles.text:
Your Proton VPN's iPhone app has just changed its look — here's all you need to know
Proton VPN 8.0 is finally on the App Store, and it brings a brand-new globe map, a tougher kill switch, and a new engine under the hood
- Proton VPN 8.0 is now rolling out on the App Store for iPhone, iPad users
- The most visible change is a new interactive globe map
- Under the hood, there's a new VPN engine and a tougher kill switch
Proton VPN's iPhone app looks a little different this week. Version 8.0 landed on the App Store on November 9, and the first thing you'll notice is a brand-new interactive globe map.
We first reported on the update earlier this month, when Proton published the 8.0.0 build on GitHub before it had reached the App Store. Now it's available to anyone running iOS 17 or later.
Proton VPN already sits among the best VPN services we've tested, and since last December, it has climbed to third place in our ranking. This release gives iPhone and iPad owners a fresh way to pick a server, plus some meaningful security upgrades.
Proton VPN – best for privacy 
Based in Switzerland, this privacy-first VPN offers good speeds, advanced anti-censorship features, and a server network that spans 145 countries around the world — including across Africa and Asia, where other providers tend to struggle. While its free VPN plan is handy, it comes with limitations. The good news is that upgrading to a premium subscription will cost you only the equivalent of $2.99 per month.
What's new in Proton VPN 8.0 for iOS
The biggest visual change is the interactive globe. When zoomed in, the view of your current country appears flat, but once you zoom out, you'll find a spinnable globe with Proton's many servers marked out for easy access.
It's the latest step in a steady refresh of the iOS app. Proton overhauled the home screen in April 2025, and a later quality-of-life update moved map pins from the middle of each country to the actual city.
The rest of the 8.0 changelog is less visible but arguably more important:
- Proton protocols: a new Rust-based VPN engine built for stability and censorship resistance.
- Advanced kill switch: blocks all internet traffic unless you're connected to Proton VPN.
- Better kill switch connectivity: you can now reach local network devices and use Apple CarPlay with the kill switch on.
- Persistent NetShield stats: your ad-blocker counts no longer reset between sessions.
NEW: Leave No Trace — A weekly newsletter on digital privacy and online surveillance.
Leave No Trace investigates the companies and governments putting our digital freedom at risk — and the people fighting back.
📩 Subscribe now to get every edition delivered to your inbox every Friday, launching this September.
What it means for you
The globe should make it easier to see where Proton's VPN servers are and where your traffic is exiting, rather than scrolling a flat list of countries.
The new engine matters more in the long run. Proton protocols replace the wireguard-go code that Proton says never sat well with Swift, the language behind its iOS app.
The advanced kill switch is the one to watch if you never want a single packet leaving your iPhone unprotected. Unlike the standard version, it stays active even after you restart your device. Proton does warn that some DNS requests from Apple's own services may still bypass the VPN.
When is it coming to other apps?
Proton hasn't said yet.
Proton protocols are already stable on Windows, and the globe map appeared in beta builds across Proton's major apps in August. But the latest stable Android release, from late October, makes no mention of it.

GPUs are her main area of interest, and nothing thrills her quite like that time every couple of years when new graphics cards hit the market.
She built her first PC nearly 20 years ago, and dozens of builds later, she’s always planning out her next build (or helping her friends with theirs). During her career, Monica has written for many tech-centric outlets, including Digital Trends, SlashGear, WePC, and Tom’s Hardware.

articles.title: Estados Unidos evalúa obligar a las empresas a avisar en sus sitios web si usan IA china
articles.text:
El gobierno de Donald Trump evalúa obligar a las empresas estadounidenses a informar públicamente cuándo usan modelos de inteligencia artificial de China, según tres personas que hablaron con la agencia Reuters. La medida busca desalentar esa dependencia sin imponer prohibiciones nuevas que puedan molestar a la industria o a Beijing.
El Departamento del Tesoro y la Oficina de Política Científica y Tecnológica de la Casa Blanca discutieron el plan, que alcanzaría a compañías como Airbnb. La plataforma de alquileres usa Qwen, un modelo de la china Alibaba, para su agente de atención al cliente.
Según el plan, firmas como Airbnb tendrían que publicar esa información en sus sitios web. Las fuentes no aclararon si la idea gana respaldo dentro del gobierno ni si pasaría a un proceso formal de reglamentación.
La Casa Blanca, el Tesoro, Alibaba y la embajada de China en Washington no respondieron de inmediato a los pedidos de comentarios de Reuters. Airbnb declinó opinar.
Reuters describió la propuesta como una campaña de señalamiento público (en inglés, name and shame), compatible con la postura general del gobierno contra regular la inteligencia artificial.
Modelos chinos más baratos y cada vez más usados
Los modelos en cuestión son de “pesos abiertos”: sus componentes centrales son públicos y cualquiera puede descargarlos y adaptarlos. Entre ellos están Kimi, de Moonshot AI, DeepSeek y Qwen. De acuerdo con la agencia Reuters, las empresas estadounidenses los adoptan porque cuestan menos que las herramientas de OpenAI y Anthropic y rinden lo suficiente.
Los sectores más duros con China temen que Beijing use esos modelos para volver dependientes a las compañías de Estados Unidos, escribió la agencia. En octubre, los tres modelos más usados en OpenRouter, una plataforma que mide el uso de IA, fueron chinos. La medición se hace por tokens, las unidades de texto que procesa y cobra un modelo.
Los modelos abiertos de origen estadounidense incluyen Muse Glimmer, de Meta, Nemotron, de Nvidia, y Beam, de Reflection AI.
Una investigación en el Congreso y amenazas de sanciones
Los republicanos Andrew Garbarino, de Nueva York, y John Moolenaar, de Michigan, presidentes de los comités de Seguridad Nacional y del comité especial sobre China de la Cámara de Representantes, abrieron este año una investigación sobre el uso de IA china por empresas estadounidenses. Enviaron cartas a Airbnb, a Anysphere y a DoorDash.
Anysphere, creadora de la herramienta de programación Cursor, construyó su modelo Composer 2 sobre una versión de Kimi. Un cofundador de DoorDash dijo que la empresa deriva algunas tareas de un sistema interno hacia Kimi. Moonshot, DoorDash y SpaceX, que compró Anysphere, no respondieron a Reuters.
En julio, el secretario del Tesoro, Scott Bessent, dijo que el gobierno podría sancionar a empresas chinas de IA si se comprueba que robaron propiedad intelectual mediante la “destilación”: entrenar modelos pequeños con las respuestas de otros más grandes. En abril, el director de esa oficina de la Casa Blanca, Michael Kratsios, acusó a China de robar esa propiedad “a escala industrial”.
La propia administración también usó IA china: Reuters informó en septiembre que un sitio web del gobierno federal empleaba un modelo de Alibaba para buscar regulaciones propuestas, aunque el FBI acusó a su desarrollador de copiar la tecnología de Anthropic.
Hasta ahora, según Reuters, los funcionarios no restringieron ni sancionaron a las empresas chinas de IA. La nota enmarca el debate en el escándalo del director ejecutivo de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, y su relación con una presunta espía china, que reavivó los pedidos de una postura más dura.
La propuesta refleja una disputa que combina competitividad tecnológica, seguridad nacional y costos empresariales, mientras Estados Unidos busca limitar la influencia de China sin cerrar el acceso a modelos de inteligencia artificial más económicos.

articles.title: Windows 11 : Microsoft Defender va surveiller ce que les pirates glissent dans votre presse-papiers
articles.text:
Microsoft commence à déployer une nouvelle protection contre les attaques ClickFix, une technique de piratage qui pousse les internautes à exécuter eux-mêmes des commandes malveillantes. L'antivirus de Windows pourra les intercepter dans le presse-papiers avant leur exécution.
Le presse-papiers de Windows n'a jamais eu vocation à devenir un outil de piratage, et pourtant, les cybercriminels ont trouvé le moyen de s'en servir pour contourner la méfiance des internautes et les amener à infecter eux-mêmes leur ordinateur. Une méthode baptisée ClickFix, qui a pris de l'ampleur ces derniers mois. À l'occasion d'Ignite 2026, Microsoft a dévoilé sa riposte : une nouvelle protection pour son antivirus Defender, conçue pour prendre les pirates de vitesse.
Désamorcer le piège avant le copier-coller fatal
Pour couper court à ces attaques, Microsoft a choisi d'intervenir avant même que la commande malveillante soit exécutée. La nouvelle protection repose sur un processus baptisé DefenderSessionHelper.exe, chargé de repérer les instructions dangereuses copiées depuis une page web et de les supprimer du presse-papiers avant qu'elles ne puissent être lancées.
Une parade qui cible directement le mode opératoire des attaques de type ClickFix. Sur un site compromis ou une page frauduleuse, les pirates affichent un faux CAPTCHA ou un message d'erreur invitant l'internaute à effectuer quelques manipulations pour confirmer son identité ou résoudre un prétendu problème technique. Dans sa forme la plus courante, la page copie une commande malveillante dans le presse-papiers, puis demande à la victime de la coller dans la fenêtre Exécuter de Windows, dans un terminal ou dans la barre d'adresse de l'Explorateur de fichiers.
Si la personne suit ces instructions, elle déclenche elle-même l'exécution de la commande, qui peut alors télécharger un logiciel malveillant, dérober des données ou ouvrir un accès à son ordinateur. Avec sa nouvelle protection, Defender entend donc briser cette chaîne d'infection avant que l'internaute ait eu l'occasion de la lancer.
ClickFix, une menace qui prolifère
Et Microsoft a de bonnes raisons de s'attaquer à cette méthode. D'après les données recueillies par Defender, les attaques ClickFix ont représenté 12,8 % des intrusions observées entre juin 2025 et juin 2026. Après un recul à la fin de l'année dernière, leur volume a été multiplié par 23 entre décembre 2025 et mai 2026, signe que cette technique de manipulation continue de séduire les cybercriminels.
Bonne nouvelle pour les particuliers, la nouvelle protection ne sera pas réservée aux entreprises. Microsoft a confirmé que son déploiement avait déjà commencé sur les appareils utilisant Microsoft Defender Antivirus, avec une généralisation prévue d'ici la fin de l'année 2026. Les équipes de sécurité des organisations équipées des solutions professionnelles de Defender pourront, de leur côté, retrouver les détections dans leur portail d'administration pour examiner les tentatives d'attaque et mener leurs investigations.
- Moteur de détection de dernière génération efficace et discret
- Intégration dans Windows 10 et Windows 11
- Pare-feu

articles.title: Cómo enfriar una habitación y gastar menos luz: el método que combina aire acondicionado y ventilador
articles.text:
Encender el aire acondicionado y el ventilador simultáneamente puede ayudar a reducir el consumo energético en casa. Aunque muchas personas consideran que utilizar ambos equipos aumenta el gasto de electricidad, los expertos señalan que esta combinación permite distribuir mejor el aire frío y evitar que el sistema de climatización trabaje a temperaturas demasiado bajas.
El ingeniero Daniel Beguería, citado por el El Español, explica que no es necesario elegir entre uno de estos aparatos. Por el contrario, utilizarlos de manera conjunta puede mejorar el confort dentro de una habitación y disminuir la exigencia sobre el aire acondicionado.
La explicación está relacionada con la manera en que el cuerpo humano percibe el calor. Un ventilador no reduce la temperatura del ambiente, pero genera una corriente de aire que favorece la evaporación del sudor y ayuda a disipar el calor corporal. Esto permite sentir mayor frescura incluso cuando el termómetro registra temperaturas elevadas.
Una habitación puede resultar confortable a 28 o 30 grados cuando existe una circulación adecuada del aire, sin necesidad de mantener el aire acondicionado a temperaturas considerablemente más bajas.
Cómo utilizar el aire acondicionado y el ventilador para ahorrar energía
La recomendación principal consiste en configurar el aire acondicionado entre 26 y 27 grados y acompañar su funcionamiento con un ventilador. De esta manera, el aire frío puede distribuirse mejor por la habitación y generar una sensación térmica agradable.
Cuando se utiliza únicamente el aire acondicionado, algunas personas suelen configurar el termostato a 22 o 23 grados para enfriar rápidamente el espacio. Sin embargo, esta práctica obliga al equipo a trabajar con mayor intensidad y puede incrementar el consumo eléctrico.
El ventilador ayuda a evitar esa situación porque permite aprovechar mejor el aire frío que ya produjo el sistema de climatización. Así, no es necesario reducir tanto la temperatura para conseguir una sensación de frescura.
Combinar ambos dispositivos puede reducir el consumo energético entre un 17% y un 73%, dependiendo de las características de la vivienda, las condiciones exteriores y los equipos utilizados.
Por qué un ventilador de techo puede ser más eficiente
No todos los ventiladores ofrecen los mismos resultados. Beguería destaca que los modelos instalados en el techo suelen ser una alternativa eficiente para distribuir el aire dentro de una habitación.
Estos dispositivos permiten mover el aire de manera más uniforme y no ocupan espacio en el suelo. Además, pueden funcionar durante periodos prolongados con un consumo eléctrico considerablemente menor al de un sistema de refrigeración mecánica.
Un ventilador de techo puede consumir alrededor de 10,4 kilovatios hora durante 800 horas de funcionamiento al año. En condiciones comparables, un aire acondicionado puede alcanzar los 392 kilovatios hora.
Esto significa que el sistema de climatización puede necesitar hasta 38 veces más energía que un ventilador de techo para proporcionar condiciones de confort similares.
Otros consejos para enfriar la casa sin aumentar el consumo eléctrico
Además de combinar ambos aparatos, existen medidas que permiten mantener una temperatura agradable sin exigir demasiado a los equipos de climatización.
Una de ellas es aprovechar la ventilación cruzada durante la noche, cuando la temperatura exterior suele ser menor. Abrir ventanas ubicadas en lados opuestos de la vivienda facilita la circulación del aire y ayuda a renovar el ambiente.
También es recomendable utilizar cortinas gruesas, persianas y elementos de protección solar para impedir que la radiación caliente directamente las habitaciones. Mejorar el aislamiento de puertas y ventanas permite conservar durante más tiempo la temperatura interior.
Por último, si el problema principal es la humedad, se puede aprovechar la función deshumidificadora del aire acondicionado. Esta característica reduce la humedad ambiental y puede mejorar la sensación de confort sin necesidad de bajar excesivamente la temperatura.
En conjunto, estas medidas permiten aprovechar mejor los equipos disponibles y reducir el esfuerzo energético necesario para mantener una habitación fresca.

Revopoint Launches MIRACO 2 on Kickstarter: Scan in One, Create with Agents
An all-in-one 3D scanner combining high-precision capture, powerful onboard computing, and AI-driven workflows—with Super Early Bird pricing starting at $1,425.
The Offer is available from today, November 18 on Kickstarter. Grab the Super Early Bird Offer, with up to 38% off, starting at $1,425. 
Back MIRACO 2 on KickstarterTruly Standalone Design with Powerful Onboard ComputingWeighing just 960 g, MIRACO 2 integrates depth computation, 3D scanning, point cloud processing, and basic editing into one portable device.
Powered by an 8-core CPU and 6-core NPU, it supports three operating modes:
- Standalone Mode: Scan, preview, process, and make adjustments directly on its 6-inch 2K AMOLED touchscreen.
- Wireless PC Mode: Connect to a computer via Wi-Fi 6 for a flexible scanning workflow.
- Wired PC Mode: Connect via USB-C 3.0 for a stable, high-performance workflow.
When connected to a GPU-powered PC, Multi-Line Laser scanning can reach speeds of up to 120 FPS.
High Precision Meets Versatile Scanning Capabilities
MIRACO 2 delivers single-frame accuracy of up to 0.02 mm in Multi-Line Laser Mode and offers six scanning modes to handle a wide range of objects and applications:
- 34-Line Blue Cross Laser
- 15-Line Parallel Laser
- Single-Line Deep-Hole Laser
- Full-Field HD
- VCSEL Rapid
- Hybrid HD
With a maximum capture rate of 10 million points per second in Hybrid HD mode, MIRACO 2 can handle challenging surfaces and geometries, including reflective metals, black objects, intricate structures, and human bodies.
Additional capabilities include:
- Markerless tracking for textured objects in laser-line modes (PC mode).
- A recommended minimum scan volume of 10 × 10 × 10 mm.
- A maximum scanning volume of 5 × 5 × 5 m when paired with the optional Photogrammetric Metrology Kit.
- VCSEL working distance ranging from 300 mm to 1,000 mm.
Revo Agents: An AI-Native Ecosystem for 3D Workflows
Capturing an object is only the beginning. Turning scan data into CAD models or inspection results often means navigating complex software and hours of manual processing.
Revo Agents is designed to change that.Introduced by Revopoint as the world's first agent-powered 3D reality ecosystem, Revo Agents acts as an AI-native engineering co-pilot, allowing users to direct complex 3D operations through simple natural language commands.
Its autonomous, prompt-driven pipeline spans:
- Real-time point cloud fusion
- Automated Scan-to-CAD conversion
- Scan-to-Inspection tolerance analysis
Rather than manually navigating each processing step, users can describe the task they want to accomplish and let Revo Agents help carry the workflow forward.
Paired with MIRACO 2, Revo Agents bridges high-precision reality capture and production-ready engineering output—reducing repetitive post-processing while keeping creators focused on design, analysis, and decisions.
You define the task. Revo Agents helps execute it.
Full-Color Capture and Physically Scaled 3DGS
MIRACO 2's dual RGB camera system combines a 2 MP near-field camera and a 50 MP far-field camera for detailed, full-color 3D capture.
In PC mode, it also supports physically scaled 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), allowing users to export 1:1-scale.splat models for XR applications and digital visualization.
AI-powered cleanup tools further simplify model preparation:
- AI Segmentation: Automatically identifies and removes unwanted environmental point clouds.
- AI Cropping: Streamlines model cleanup and editing.
Together with Revopoint's software ecosystem, these capabilities support an integrated Scan-to-CAD workflow, helping users move from physical objects to usable digital models.
Built for Indoor and Outdoor Work
Designed for both indoor and outdoor applications, it supports ambient lighting conditions of up to 100,000 lux. Its 10,000 mAh battery provides approximately three hours of runtime, with 65 W fast charging.
Two configurations are available:
- 16 GB RAM + 256 GB storage
- 32 GB RAM + 512 GB storage

articles.title: Visa confirms apparent cyberattack, hackers also claim hit on JPMorgan
articles.text:
Visa confirms apparent cyberattack, hackers also claim hit on JPMorgan
Payment data is secure, Visa says
- Emerging ransomware group n0n claims to have stolen data from Visa and JPMorgan Chase, threatening public leaks unless paid
- Visa acknowledged a third-party security incident, while JPMorgan said recent service disruptions were caused by a software bug
- Researchers describe n0n as a fast-growing extortion group that increasingly relies on AI-assisted tooling and data theft
A relatively new ransomware actor called n0n is trying to make a name for itself, apparently at the expense of finance powerhouses Visa and JPMorgan Chase.
The group recently added both companies to its data leak website, claiming to have stolen sensitive data from their servers and giving them mere 48 hours to pay the ransom demand. If that doesn’t happen, n0n threatens to leak everything it stole on the dark web.
Whether or not the group actually stole anything, and if so - what - remains to be seen. The group did not post a sample on its website (which is not that uncommon), did not describe the nature of the stolen files, and did not discuss where exactly it broke in and how.
The deadline is quite tight, even for ransomware terms, so whether or not there’s any merit to n0n’s claims will be known soon enough.
Visa and JPM Chase respond
At the same time, both Visa and JPMorgan Chase responded to the claims, each in their own way. Visa partially confirmed the claims, while JPM outright denied everything.
Visa, the global payments technology behemoth, said it was aware of the claims made by n0n and added it was investigating, Cybernews reports. The company said there was a cybersecurity incident involving a third-party provider, but stressed its own systems were not involved or impacted. Apparently, there is no indication payment card data was affected either.
“Visa’s systems were not involved and were not impacted. There is no indication that payment data such as card numbers have been affected,” Visa’s spokesperson told Cybernews. The company did not say which third-party service provider that was, or how it was attacked.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
Even if payment data is safe, other information can also be used in stage-two attacks quite well.
On the other hand, American banking giant JPMorgan Chase said it was experiencing a service outage caused by a software bug - not a cyberattack.
"JPMorgan Chase has experienced a temporary issue related to a software bug in on-premise hardware systems – there is no evidence it is cyber-related. It is taking longer than usual to service some customers," a spokesperson for the bank told Reuters.
Customer accounts and funds are still accessible, the bank said, adding that it was working hard to resolve the issue. "This is not a systemic issue – other banks may have been impacted by slowness in transactions only to the extent that they were a party to a transaction with us," the spokesperson added.
Who is n0n?
If you haven’t heard of n0n before, don’t worry - this is a new threat actor that only emerged in September 2026.
N0n focuses on ransomware and data collection attacks, operating the classic double-extortion model (steals data then encrypts systems). Everything it does, it reports on its Tor-based leak site. According to threat intelligence researchers SOCRadar, the group has exploited compromised credentials, exposed cloud access keys and vulnerable remote-access infrastructure to infiltrate organizations.
The researchers claim n0n are heavy AI users, saying they discovered evidence of AI coding agents being used to develop and maintain attack tools. Researchers ZeroFox assess n0n as a financially motivated, opportunistic threat actor with low-to-medium technical sophistication. At this time, it is unknown how big the group is, where it operates from, or who runs it.
Ransomware analysts Ransomnews have so far recorded 365 victims, which is quite the number to achieve in less than three months. Among them are household names like CarNow, Patagonia, and Wise Advisory Group. It also seems to be heavily focused on the pharmaceutical industry, since Ransomnews tracks dozens of victims from that vertical alone.

articles.title: GTA VI décroche 99/100 sur Metacritic et rejoint enfin le seul jeu qui régnait depuis 28 ans
articles.text:
Il aura fallu attendre vingt-huit ans pour voir un jeu se hisser aux côtés de Zelda: Ocarina of Time. À la veille de sa sortie, GTA VI compte déjà 145 critiques positives sur Metacritic. Qu’a donc trouvé la presse à Vice City pour lui faire un tel accueil ?
Treize ans qu’on attend de pouvoir écrire ces mots : demain, on retourne à Vice City. Ceux qui ont connu la ville sur PS2 y ont encore une station de radio préférée. D’autres ont grandi à Los Santos et s’apprêtent à la découvrir pour la première fois. On se demande tous un peu la même chose : une fois la manette en main, où est-ce qu’on file en premier ? Les journalistes qui ont déjà passé des dizaines d’heures sur GTA VI avaient un sacré avantage sur nous. À lire leurs tests, certains ont pourtant eu un mal fou à se décider à finir le jeu. Et les raisons qu’ils donnent sont encore plus réjouissantes que ce fameux 99/100.
BenQ iScreenBar : la barre lumineuse qui s’accorde avec l’iMac
Des lignes en harmonie avec celles de l’ordinateur d’Apple, une conception rigoureuse, des matériaux sélectionnés, rien n’a été laissé au hasard, tout comme le service qu’elle rend une fois allumée !
GTA VI en tête de Metacritic, à égalité avec Ocarina of Time
Il faut remonter à 1998, à la Nintendo 64 et au jour où Link est sorti de la forêt pour découvrir la plaine d’Hyrule. Depuis, combien de jeux a-t-on vu passer sans que personne vienne déloger Ocarina of Time ? Ce 18 novembre, Metacritic attribue 99/100 à GTA VI sur PS5. Le site le place en tête de son classement général, juste devant Zelda, qui affiche exactement la même note. Sur la fiche de GTA VI, les 145 critiques recensées à l’heure où nous écrivons sont toutes positives.
Côté français, Gamekult, Gameblog et IGN France accordent tous trois à GTA VI la note maximale sur le barème de Metacritic. Mais ce qui retient Gamekult, c’est la patience nouvelle de Rockstar : à laisser souffler Jason et Lucia entre deux coups, le studio prend le risque de perdre les plus pressés et gagne le temps de nous attacher à eux. Gameblog en raconte l’autre bout, ce petit vide qui s’installe quand le générique défile et qu’on aimerait bien passer encore un moment avec le couple.
Le plus beau braquage de Rockstar, c’est Jason et Lucia
Trevor, Michael et Franklin avaient chacun leurs raisons de courir après l’argent. Jason et Lucia, eux, aimeraient en mettre assez de côté pour pouvoir un jour raccrocher ensemble. La nuance change jusqu’à la façon de jouer. The Verge raconte qu’entre deux grands braquages, on peut alimenter la cagnotte du couple en revendant une voiture volée ou en allant chercher un trésor au fond de la mer, le prochain gros coup peut attendre.
Dans le Guardian, Keza MacDonald, qui a souvent levé les yeux au ciel devant la façon dont GTA traitait les femmes, raconte combien elle s’est attachée à Lucia et Jason. Le journaliste du Washington Post en donne peut-être la plus belle illustration : après 120 heures, il ne s’était toujours pas résolu à leur faire tuer des innocents, même par curiosité. Si vous avez déjà semé une pagaille monstre dans un GTA juste pour voir combien de temps vous tiendriez, vous mesurez le tour de force. Cette fois, on se soucie de ce qu’ils vont devenir.
Vice City se découvre aussi entre deux feux rouges
The Verge raconte une anecdote qui va vous faire sourire : un SMS arrive alors qu’on conduit, on sort le portable pour le lire et, pendant ce temps, la voiture continue de rouler… On finit donc par faire dans GTA ce qu’on aurait dû faire depuis longtemps dans la vraie vie : se garer ! Ars Technica s’attarde de son côté sur les intérieurs et sur ces moments de calme que Rockstar glisse entre deux courses-poursuites. On peut aider un voisin à bricoler sa voiture ou faire griller des burgers au bord de l’eau…voilà qui explique peut-être pourquoi des journalistes pressés par une embargo, ont tout de même trouvé le temps de jouer au minigolf.
En France, Julien Chièze dit avoir bouclé l’histoire en une cinquantaine d’heures et passé près du double dans le Leonida. Il retient notamment le comportement des véhicules, assez différent d’un modèle à l’autre pour donner envie d’en essayer un de plus. Son enthousiasme a pourtant une limite : à force de soigner la mise en scène et de vouloir que tout s’enchaîne sans accroc, Rockstar laisse parfois les amateurs de défi sur leur faim. Et si votre plaisir, dans GTA V, était de sillonner la ville derrière le pare-brise, il relève que la conduite en vue intérieure manque à l’appel.
Sur PS5 Pro, Rob Dwiar, qui approche la centaine d’heures de jeu pour TechRadar, aurait volontiers échangé un peu de cette splendeur contre une animation plus fluide que les 30 images par seconde visées. Le débat risque de nous occuper un moment, tout comme les huit nominations de GTA VI aux Game Awards. Mais demain, quand le jeu sera lancé sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, on doute que les notes nous occupent bien longtemps. On aura enfin les clés de Vice City.

articles.title: GTA 6 coloca provedores de internet no Brasil em alerta • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
GTA 6 coloca provedores de internet no Brasil em alerta
Com 212 GB, jogo já provocou picos de tráfego no exterior durante o pré-download. Ao Tecnoblog, operadoras afirmam que monitoram a demanda.
O lançamento de Grand Theft Auto 6 deve aumentar a pressão sobre a infraestrutura de internet em diferentes países. Com 212 GB, o jogo já provocou picos expressivos de tráfego durante o pré-download, iniciado na semana passada. No Brasil, provedores ouvidos pelo Tecnoblog se preparam para o aumento da demanda com a estreia.
Ao contrário do que parece, GTA 6 ainda não foi oficialmente liberado no país. A estreia está marcada para 0h desta quinta-feira (19/11), nos PlayStation 5 e Xbox Series X/S. No entanto, além de jornalistas com acesso antecipado, alguns jogadores conseguiram acessar o título no Xbox ao mudar a região do console para a Nova Zelândia, aproveitando a diferença de fuso horário. A prática é permitida pela Microsoft.
O jogo também acompanha conteúdos de serviço para os fãs. A lista de códigos do GTA 6 reúne 61 trapaças.
A Vivo informou ao Tecnoblog que monitora o tráfego e “está preparada para as variações de demanda associadas” a GTA 6. Segundo a operadora, há “ferramentas de monitoramento em tempo real e equipes especializadas para acompanhar o desempenho da sua rede”.
Já a TIM nos informou que acompanha a “evolução do tráfego em sua rede e está preparada para atender a aumentos pontuais de demanda associados a grandes lançamentos digitais, como o GTA 6“.
De acordo com a companhia, a infraestrutura “vem sendo continuamente modernizada para acompanhar o crescimento acelerado do consumo de dados”.
Já o NIC.br, entidade que atua na infraestrutura da internet no Brasil, afirmou ao Tecnoblog que ainda não há dados suficientes para estimar o impacto de GTA 6 no tráfego nacional. Contudo, a organização ressalta que, no dia a dia, o streaming de vídeo responde pelo maior volume de dados, à frente do tráfego gerado por empresas de games.
No Reino Unido, operadoras esperam uma procura excepcional por conexão à internet a partir do lançamento. Segundo uma pesquisa da Uswitch, cerca de 2,8 milhões de adultos no país pretendem jogar GTA 6 na estreia.
A BT, uma das maiores empresas de telecomunicações britânicas, registrou o segundo maior pico de tráfego de banda larga de sua história durante o pré-download do jogo, em 10/11. O único evento que superou a marca foi a partida entre Arsenal e Atlético de Madrid pela semifinal da Champions League, em 5 de maio.
A dimensão do lançamento acompanha a expectativa em torno da franquia. GTA 6 chega 13 anos depois de Grand Theft Auto V, lançado em 2013 e responsável por mais de 230 milhões de cópias vendidas.
Além do jogo, a Rockstar anunciou o Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival, evento marcado para 21/11, no espaço Mana Wynwood, em Miami. O festival terá dois palcos e reunirá artistas ligados ao game e à trilha sonora, como Travis Scott e Justice.
A cidade também terá uma celebração dentro da NBA. Nesta quarta-feira (18/11), o Miami Heat enfrenta o Milwaukee Bucks em uma partida temática inspirada em Vice City, cidade fictícia baseada em Miami que serve de cenário para o novo jogo.
No Brasil, a mobilização em torno do lançamento também inclui uma transmissão ao vivo organizada pela TIM, com criadores de conteúdo jogando GTA 6 na loja conceito da operadora, em São Paulo, a partir da meia-noite.
A trama de GTA 6 acompanha Lucia Caminos, primeira protagonista feminina jogável da franquia, e Jason Duval. A história se passa no estado fictício de Leonida, que a Rockstar descreve como seu mundo aberto mais detalhado até agora.

articles.title: JEDEC Previews Next-Generation DDR6 DRAM
articles.text:
Wednesday, November 18th 2026
JEDEC Previews Next-Generation DDR6 DRAM
JEDEC Solid State Technology Association, the global leader in the development of standards for the microelectronics industry, today unveiled a preview of its DDR6 DRAM standard, the next-generation main memory standard designed to support the accelerating demands of AI, cloud, data center, server and client computing. Currently in development in JEDEC, DDR6 will introduce a new architecture aimed at delivering significant gains in bandwidth, capacity, power efficiency and reliability, helping to enable the next era of high-performance computing.
The following features reflect current JEDEC DDR6 development plans rather than a finalized standard, and are subject to change through JEDEC's development and approval process:
Increased Performance
- Higher bandwidth: Improved data rates and a wider bus will combine to increase bandwidth more than 50% at introduction, with further bandwidth increases as data rates increase. This bandwidth target is distinct from a claim of equivalent improvement in application performance.
- Higher data rates: DDR6 RDIMMs move beyond DDR5's 9.2 GT/s to a data rate that will start at 12.8 GT/s with a roadmap extending to 14.4 GT/s and beyond.
- Wider bus: The data bus expands from 64 to 96 DQ, a 50% increase in data bus width.
- Pseudo-channel architecture: DDR6's planned architecture organizes memory access into pseudo-channels to support higher bandwidth per DRAM package. It is intended to provide greater configuration flexibility for system reliability and more efficient data movement.
- Higher bank availability: 2X bank count and improved refresh boost data bus efficiency, enabling system performance at higher speed grades and higher capacities.
Higher Capacities
- Higher DRAM density: Support for up to 128 Gb DRAM die density.
- Efficient capacity scaling: Optimizations for die stacking in DDR6 packages delivers more density per package footprint.
- Compact module footprint: A significantly narrower 74 mm DDR6 module length, compared with 133 mm for DDR5, is intended to help accommodate higher system memory density.
Reliability
- Flexible reliability: Support for multiple system error-correcting code (ECC) implementations will allow system designers to balance cost, power, and reliability at the system level.
- Built for the data center: Interface optimized for high-capacity modules with configurations oriented to general purpose compute as well as AI inferencing and agentic AI, which demand more capacity and performance close to the CPU.
Energy Efficiency
- Improved performance-per-watt: DDR6 targets significantly improved performance-per-watt versus DDR5 through a change to VSS-terminated IO and data-center-focused low power modes.
Form Factors
- Breadth of form factors: DDR6 is being defined across multiple form factors—potentially including RDIMM, UDIMM, and CAMM to serve a broad range of applications while balancing reliability, performance, power, and cost.
Christopher Cox, Chair of the JC-42 Committee for Solid State Memories"As AI and data-intensive workloads continue to drive system requirements higher, DDR6 is being designed to deliver meaningful advances in memory bandwidth, capacity, and reliability. The collaboration of JEDEC member companies is helping create a next-generation memory standard that balances performance, power efficiency, and scalability across a broad range of computing applications."
Mian Quddus, JEDEC Board of Directors Chairman"JEDEC members gain early access to pre-publication proposals and insights into active projects such as DDR6. We welcome interested companies worldwide to join JEDEC today to help shape the future of standards for this dynamic industry."
21 Comments on JEDEC Previews Next-Generation DDR6 DRAM
Now, when the final DDR6 will be released?
Compact module footprint: A significantly narrower 74 mm DDR6 module length, compared with 133 mm for DDR5, is intended to help accommodate higher system memory density.
Not as good as CAMM but still improves signal integrity a bit, not having to route signals across 13cm long connector.
All production for 2027 has been reserved.
I don’t remember off the top of my head, but does CAMM also need a CKD to reach higher frequencies like conventional DIMMs? If not, that’s theoretically an advantage on costs. If yes, yeah, then you have a good point.
I’m currently using DDR12 myself. But who cares?
The retooling alone is billions of $
Let them play their own music and dance to their own tune.
DDR5 was very expensive at launch, in the current market it's more expensive than it ever was, and I expect DDR6 will be more with the excuse that it's faster.DDR12? Are you from the future?
I think the specification was supposed to have been released this year and clearly isn't given this announcement. The only thing I can think of is that given the mempocalypse they're kicking the can down the road and it will be next year. With DDR5 we saw it on client first, but I'd be surprised if that happened with DDR6 even if validation for enterprise takes longer. Really unfortunate for something that stands to be the biggest change for the memory market since dual channel.

articles.title: AI workflow automation: 3 monday.com Elevate insights - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Three insights you may have missed from theCUBE’s coverage of monday.com’s Elevate event
AI workflow automation is changing how businesses build applications and manage everyday work, raising questions about the role of established software platforms. As organizations experiment with AI-generated applications and autonomous agents, they must also determine how to maintain access controls, integrate existing systems and manage increasingly complex workflows.
The growing accessibility of AI development tools has prompted speculation that businesses could replace traditional software-as-a-service platforms with applications built for specific needs. But building an application and operating it securely across an enterprise present different challenges, according to Casey George, chief revenue officer of monday.com Ltd.
“We are seeing customers come back to a platform that’s integrated — that’s governed, that’s permissioned with their infrastructure, that is secure — like monday.com,” he told theCUBE. “I joke and say it was an expensive funeral, but we learned a lot. Customers learned a lot.”
George, along with executives and practitioners, spoke with host Rebecca Knight at monday.com’s Elevate event during an exclusive broadcast on theCUBE, SiliconANGLE Media’s livestreaming studio. The discussions examined enterprise AI deployment, governance requirements and the challenges of scaling AI workflow automation across organizations. (* Disclosure below.)
Here’s theCUBE’s complete video interview with Casey George:
Here are three insights you may have missed from theCUBE’s coverage of monday.com’s Elevate event:
Insight #1: Deploying AI agents requires expertise and governance.
Making autonomous agents available to employees does not guarantee business returns. After an internal initiative produced more than 3,600 agents, monday.com established monday Frontier, an organization combining managed services and deployment engineers to help customers identify workflow bottlenecks and implement AI projects. The initiative addresses the implementation challenges involved in moving agents into productive use, according to Eran Zinman (pictured), co-founder and co-chief executive officer of monday.com.
“Adopting AI really requires expertise. I know how hard it is because we experienced ourselves that you have this amazing technology, but how do you actually use it?” he said during the event.
As organizations deploy AI agents, security teams must account for how access rights change across users, applications and environments. Incremental rollouts offer a way to test capabilities before expanding their reach, while permission management remains an ongoing responsibility, according to Ryan Nigro, security trust and enablement team lead at monday.com.
“It just comes to making sure that your users are properly being given just enough to do their roles but not too much to cause harm,” Nigro told theCUBE. “There’s no reason why a sales rep should have the ability to change your production environment.”
Here’s theCUBE’s complete video interview with Ryan Nigro:
Insight #2: Shared dashboards improve operational visibility.
At Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co., employees are using monday vibe, monday.com’s no-code application builder, to create custom tools. One executive dashboard replaces the manual process of copying charts into presentation slides while retaining the ability to export to PowerPoint, according to Kate Kenner, capability and community lead for strategic sourcing and planning at HPE.
“[Executives] knocked a whole bunch of the meetings off the calendar,” she told theCUBE. “Instead of weekly, now they’re monthly.”
Here’s theCUBE’s complete video interview with Kate Kenner:
At Lowe’s Cos. Inc., coordinating store setups and remodels once required tracking information across Microsoft Excel, emails and other communications. The retailer now uses monday.com to monitor individual store bays and dozens of simultaneous projects, according to Lanny Finley, director of remerch and new stores at Lowe’s.
“I can take the dashboard and see which projects are on track, which ones are at risk, and then make the appropriate actions and get the right partners in place to make the corrections to get everything back on track and completed,” he said during the event.
Lowe’s also developed an internal Green Dot Board to track issues such as missing components during store projects. The company is exploring additional automation that could initiate vendor orders when components are needed and close issues once replacements are installed, according to Brian Olms, senior business partner manager at Lowe’s, who joined Finley during the discussion.
“We needed a way to automate the process, make it more user-friendly [and] make it simpler. That’s what we started the Green Dot Board for,” he told theCUBE. “Here at Elevate, we’re seeing ways that we could even take it a step further and start to use agents and more automation and [the] vibe app.”
Here’s theCUBE’s complete video interview with Lanny Finley and Brian Olms:
Insight #3: AI workflow automation expands organizational capacity.
For nonprofits facing growing demand, AI workflow automation offers a way to expand organizational capacity without placing additional administrative burdens on employees. At Feed the Children Inc., a two-person team oversees relationships with more than 500 community partners, according to Colleen Finn Ridenhour, chief growth and strategy officer at Feed the Children.
“Things from [memorandums of understanding] and legal contracts, annual renewals and compliance and reporting — it’s quite a lot. It’s been a very manual process, historically, for them to keep track of that all the time. We really want them focused on the human element of that job, which is bringing in new partners to help us scale our impact,” she told theCUBE.
The nonprofit uses monday.com’s forms, boards, automations and agents to coordinate partner activities and manage information. Employees can also build dashboards for specific needs, including budget tracking, while retaining human oversight of compliance-related work, according to Ridenhour.
“We’re not going to be able to scale our impact by just always asking people to work harder. [We need to find] ways to repeat a lot of these repetitive actions in a much easier way and [share] information so [that] people’s jobs get easier and it frees up their time to do the things that only they can do,” she said during the event.

articles.title: Bitcoin: cuál es el valor de esta criptomoneda
articles.text:
El bitcoin, la primera moneda virtual lanzada al mercado, fue creado por Satoshi Nakamoto (pseudónimo) en 2008 tras la crisis financiera que afectó al mundo; esta divisa digital tenía como base un ideal libertario y buscaba poner en jaque a las instituciones monetarias y financieras tradicionales.
Conocido en el mundo de los mercados bajo las siglas BTC, el bitcoin utiliza la criptografía para garantizar que su gestión sea descentralizada, es decir, que no pueda ser regulado por ninguna institución u organismo bancario, lo que a su vez hace que las criptomonedas sean volátiles.
Pese al avance y alcance que ha tenido el Bitcoin y otros activos digitales de gran talla como Ethereum, organismos como el Banco Mundial, el Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) y el Banco Interamericano de Desarrollo (BID) aún se muestran dudosos sobre los "pros" de este tipo de criptomonedas.
La victoria electoral de Donald Trump significó un movimiento positivo para las principales criptomonedas del mercado. A finales de 2024, bitcoin registró un nuevo máximo histórico que logró superar los 107.000 dólares por unidad, después de que el presidente estadounidense reiteró su idea de crear una reserva estratégica de la criptodivisa en Estados Unidos.
Las divisas digitales serán un foco de atención durante este año, las iniciativas del presidente de Estados Unidos y el desarrollo de nuevos modelos de inteligencia artificial fungirán un papel importante en la cotización de estos activos. Después del lanzamiento del nuevo modelo de IA chino DeepSeek, BTC y otras criptos cayeron en la mayoría de los mercados de valores.
Cotización de la criptomoneda Bitcoin
El precio de la criptomoneda bitcoin para este día a las 14:00 horas (UTC) es de 64063.59 dólares. Esto quiere decir que la moneda digital presentó un cambio de -1.31% en el último día, así como un movimiento de 0.0% en la última hora.
Por su nivel de capitalización, esta moneda digital ocupa la posición #1 entre las más populares.
Bitcoin alcanzó su máximo histórico
En marzo del año pasado el bitcoin ha logrado un nuevo máximo histórico, superando los valores anteriores y reafirmándose como la criptomoneda más importante en el mercado, acercándose a los 73 mil dólares. Este récord se obtuvo en medio de un flujo sin precedentes de inversiones hacia las criptomonedas, un acontecimiento notable para el sector financiero digital.
El aumento en el valor de bitcoin ocurre en un contexto donde hay un entrante masivo de capital hacia las criptomonedas, lo que indica un creciente interés y confianza de los inversores en estos activos. La subida del precio beneficia no solo a bitcoin sino que también tiene un impacto positivo en el mercado de las criptomonedas en general, favoreciendo una mayor estabilidad y visibilidad, de acuerdo a un análisis de Bloomberg.
Expertos financiaron este aumento a diferentes factores, como la adopción institucional de las criptomonedas, la búsqueda de alternativas de inversión debido a la incertidumbre económica mundial y la innovación continua en la tecnología blockchain que respalda a bitcoin y otras divisas digitales. Esta combinación de factores ha creado un entorno propicio para el crecimiento continuo en el valor de Bitcoin.
Cómo adquirir criptomonedas
Para comprarlas e intercambiarlas se utilizan portales especializados. Su valor varía en función de la oferta, de la demanda y del compromiso de los usuarios, por lo que puede cambiar más rápido que el dinero tradicional, pero mientras más gente esté interesada y quiera comprar determinada divisa, mayor será su valor.
No obstante, quien invierte en este tipo de monedas digitales debe tener muy claro que esta forma trae consigo un elevado riesgo al capital, pues, así como puede haber un incremento, también puede tener inesperadamente un desplome y acabar con los ahorros de sus usuarios.
Para almacenarlas, los usuarios deben contar con un monedero digital o wallet, que en realidad es un software a través del cual es posible guardar, enviar y hacer transacciones de las criptomonedas. En realidad, este tipo de monederos sólo guarda las claves que marcan la propiedad y el derecho de una persona sobre cierta criptomoneda, por lo que estos códigos son los que en realidad se deben proteger.

articles.title: Surfshark's proprietary 'Dausos' protocol now powers automatic connections on Mac
articles.text:
Surfshark's proprietary 'Dausos' protocol now powers automatic connections on Mac
Surfshark macOS app can now automatically connect to Dausos when it’s the best option
- Surfshark adds its proprietary Dausos protocol as the default option on Mac
- The app can now automatically connect to Dausos when it’s the best option
- The news comes a little over seven months after Surfshark released Dausos
Surfshark’s proprietary Dausos protocol will now be the default option for macOS users.
In an attempt to provide the best VPN possible for its customers, Surfshark explains that users can now automatically connect to Dausos when it's the best available protocol for their connection without having to do it themselves.
In a statement, Surfshark said: "Instead of manually switching between protocols, the app does the work for you — testing, adapting, and choosing the fastest and most stable option in real time."
Surfshark – the best cheap VPN
Surfshark is a fast, easy-to-use VPN that seriously beats the competition when it comes to subscription pricing. Its two-year Starter plan works out at $2.49 a month (plus tax), but we think Surfshark One is the best value plan as it adds an antivirus, data breach monitor, alternative ID, and now new anti-scam tools. All of this starting from the equivalent of  just $2.79 a month. 
What this update means for you
Surfshark launched Dausos in April this year.
The company claims the protocol is both up to 30 per cent faster than its rivals and it also works "dynamically" to match network conditions. This means that, at least in theory, it should keep performing at its optimal speed regardless of whether the connection is WiFi, fibre broadband, or mobile.
Dausos also includes post-quantum encryption protections to protect users from future threats.
As Surfshark explains, by adding Dausos as an automatic connection protocol, it makes it easier for users to benefit from these advantages without needing to understand the technical differences.
"The app will now consider Dausos alongside other protocols and select it when it offers the best performance for your situation," the company states.
When heading to VPN Settings and clicking on the Protocol tab on Surfshark's macOS app, users can now either choose Auto Protocol if they want Dausos to be automatically considered, or select Dausos directly for manual control.
NEW: Leave No Trace — A weekly newsletter on digital privacy and online surveillance.
Leave No Trace investigates the companies and governments putting our digital freedom at risk — and the people fighting back.
📩 Subscribe now to get every edition delivered to your inbox every Friday, launching this September.
How Dausos is built
Surfshark said it built Dausos from the ground up "to address the limitations of existing protocols, which were originally created for enterprise environments and later adapted for consumer use."
Dausos, which shares its name with the Lithuanian word for 'heaven', is different from most other VPN protocols because it uses encryption called AEGIS-256X2. According to Surfshark, it is much faster than the industry standard AES-GCM encryption, especially on modern hardware.
In addition to offering its users faster speeds, the protocol also claims to give people better protection. While most VPN protocols use a "single-tunnel" system, which means that users share the same connection to the server, Dausos gives people their own separate and private data channel.
This, in turn, should mean that people enjoy a smoother experience with fewer slowdowns, particularly at peak times, while the system protects travelling data packets from external interference.
Dausos also has a variety of security features, including key management security and a port randomisation technique, which establishes a range of port connections, unlike traditional systems that connect to a fixed port.
In August this year, Surfshark added a built-in filter that lets users block unwanted websites. Previously, people had to switch over to the WireGuard protocol to do so.
At the time of writing, Surfshark's proprietary protocol is only available on Mac. TechRadar reached out to the provider to ask whether and when support for the Dausos will be extended to other apps, but we are still waiting for an answer at the time of publication.

articles.title: Starship est déjà la plus grande fusée du monde, sa prochaine itération sera encore plus gigantesque
articles.text:
Après l’exploit de la récupération du second étage de Starship, Elon Musk pense déjà à la suite. La prochaine version de sa mégafusée sera encore plus grande, et définitivement plus puissante.
Car le 15e vol de Starship a marqué un véritable tournant pour SpaceX, même si le booster Super Heavy a dû abandonner sa tentative de retour et a fini sa course dans le golfe du Mexique. Car le Ship, c’est-à-dire le second étage, est revenu se loger dans les bras mécaniques de la tour de lancement après avoir réalisé 14 tours de la Terre. Au passage, il a largué 26 satellites Starlink V3 en orbite. Un succès immense pour ce colosse de 124 mètres, voué à devenir encore plus grand.
De 124 à 150 mètres
Dans une publication sur X.com, Elon Musk a en effet levé le voile sur la future version de sa fusée, la V4. Si l’on connaissait certains détails, l’homme le plus riche du monde a été encore plus loin. « Le Starship V4 mesurera environ 70 mètres, soit environ 40 % de longueur en plus, ce qui permet d’embarquer plus de 60 % de propergols supplémentaires », a-t-il indiqué. Il mesure aujourd’hui 52 mètres.
Ainsi, cette nouvelle itération atteindrait à peu près la taille d’un Falcon 9 complet. Et il sera également mieux armé : « Le nombre de moteurs sera porté à 9 (Ndlr : contre 6 aujourd’hui), avec trois moteurs Raptor Vacuum supplémentaires, et il s’agira de moteurs V4 à plus forte poussée », a-t-il précisé, en référence à la version des moteurs optimisée pour le vide spatial.
Au final, cette montée en gamme devrait donner naissance à un très beau bébé de 150 mètres environ, estime l’entrepreneur. C’est légèrement moins de la moitié de la tour Eiffel.
Direction la Lune
Outre la capacité à emporter des charges encore plus lourdes, c’est aussi le programme Artemis qui est en jeu. Car avant d’acheminer des astronautes sur la Lune, Starship devra faire le plein en orbite grâce à une série de vaisseaux-ravitailleurs. Avec la V4, capable selon Musk de livrer plus de 200 tonnes de propergols à chaque vol, le plein se ferait même en 5 ou 6 lancements.
Autre bonne nouvelle pour SpaceX : le second étage semble en plutôt bon état. » Dans l’ensemble, il a l’air super. Les moteurs aussi », a écrit le milliardaire, estimant qu’il pourrait voler à nouveau après « quelques semaines » de remise en état. C’est une condition sine qua non afin d’atteindre les objectifs de l’entreprise. Starship devra, à terme, être lancée plusieurs fois par jour.
Mais la route est encore longue, car elle doit désormais réussir à récupérer ses deux étages lors du même vol.
