articles.title: NVIDIA Expands Commitments With Supply Chain Partners to Support AI Infrastructure Buildout
articles.text:
Wednesday, November 18th 2026
NVIDIA Expands Commitments With Supply Chain Partners to Support AI Infrastructure Buildout
NVIDIA today announced expanded commitments with supply chain partners to support sustainable long-term growth, aligning supply and manufacturing capacity with demand for its accelerated computing and AI infrastructure platforms.
Working with Amkor Technology, Foxconn, Kinsus Interconnect Technology, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, Siliconware Precision Industries (SPIL) and TSMC, NVIDIA is expanding manufacturing capacity across substrates, advanced packaging, wafer and contract manufacturing to scale production of its current and next-generation accelerated computing platforms."Our supply chain is a strategic advantage," said Debora Shoquist, executive vice president of operations at NVIDIA. "Our work with these partners builds on our manufacturing foundation for long-term growth, expanding capacity across components, advanced packaging and system production to deliver the accelerated computing platforms our customers need."
Increasing Substrate Capacity and Production Capabilities
NVIDIA is expanding its substrate supply commitments with Kinsus and Samsung Electro-Mechanics, adding manufacturing capacity and improving production capabilities at existing factories.
Under a new agreement with NVIDIA, Kinsus plans to expand its advanced ABF package substrate manufacturing capacity dedicated to NVIDIA by more than 3.5x over current levels from its Youth campus in Taoyuan, Taiwan.
Production is expected to begin in the second half of 2027, with the additional capacity targeted for the third quarter of 2028. This multiyear agreement builds on the companies' existing supplier relationship and supports NVIDIA's long-term supply planning for its accelerated computing platforms.
"We believe AI will be one of the most important technology transitions of our lifetime," said Scott Chen, CEO and president of Kinsus. "After more than a decade of partnership with NVIDIA, we are excited to continue building the future together."
NVIDIA and Samsung Electro-Mechanics have amended their existing substrate supply agreement to improve operational capabilities at existing factories in support of increased production of NVIDIA's accelerated computing platforms.
The amendment builds on the companies' previously announced multiyear collaboration supporting substrate manufacturing in Sejong and Busan, South Korea, for NVIDIA's compute and high-speed networking technologies.
"By combining our world-class substrate fine-processing technology and high-reliability MLCC technology, we will perfectly fulfill our role as a total solution provider so that NVIDIA's AI platform can be supplied to the global market on time, with the highest performance and quality," said Duck-Hyun Chang, CEO of Samsung Electro-Mechanics. 
Scaling Advanced Packaging Through Multiyear Agreements
NVIDIA's advanced packaging plans include a new capacity expansion with SPIL and previously announced agreements supporting Amkor's manufacturing expansion in the U.S. and South Korea.
NVIDIA is supporting Amkor's expansion of advanced packaging capacity in Arizona and South Korea through multiyear agreements announced in July and October 2026, totaling nearly $3 billion. The agreements include prepayments to help Amkor scale manufacturing capacity for NVIDIA's long-term production needs.
"Our agreements with NVIDIA support investments in Arizona and South Korea that will serve multiple generations of AI platforms," said Kevin Engel, president and CEO of Amkor. "That long-term planning allows us to advance our packaging technologies and add manufacturing capacity as NVIDIA's production needs grow."
NVIDIA and SPIL are expanding advanced packaging operations in Taiwan under a multiyear agreement supported by multibillion-dollar funding from NVIDIA. The expansion will increase contracted advanced packaging capacity dedicated to NVIDIA by mid-2029.
The project includes new production lines with turnkey support spanning bumping, interposer wafer fabrication, assembly and testing. These capabilities support semiconductor products with demanding requirements for computing performance, bandwidth, power efficiency and system integration.
"SPIL is proud to strengthen our collaboration with NVIDIA," said C.W. Tsai, CEO and chairman of the board of SPIL. "This agreement enhances our ability to support next-generation packaging technologies and deliver the performance and reliability required for future AI systems."
Next-Generation Technologies for Agentic AI
The third quarter marked the first volume shipment of NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 and Vera CPUs for agentic AI. These products take advantage of TSMC's 5 nm, 3 nm and CoWoS advanced packaging technologies.
"TSMC and NVIDIA share a longstanding partnership built on semiconductor innovation," said Dr. Kevin Zhang, senior vice president and deputy co-COO at TSMC. "This deep collaboration allows us to plan for future technology requirements and prepare our manufacturing capabilities as NVIDIA brings new platforms to market."
Leveraging Global Manufacturing Footprint for GPU and Networking Platforms
"Foxconn continues to deepen its collaboration with NVIDIA across next-generation GPU and networking platforms," said Young Liu, chairman of Foxconn. "By leveraging its integrated global production network spanning Asia, North America, and Europe, Foxconn is well-positioned to support the volume ramp-up of next-generation AI infrastructure."
Building on Global Supply Chain Expansion
These commitments build on NVIDIA's decades-long partnerships and recent commitments announced in October for manufacturing expansions with Amkor, IBIDEN, King Yuan Electronics (KYEC), Samsung Electro-Mechanics, SPIL and Unimicron. Those plans included an aggregate 2.5x increase in substrate capacity over three years, expanded advanced packaging, a doubling of semiconductor testing capacity from 2026 to 2027 and a 15x increase in SPIL's optical-engine capacity by mid-2027, with aims for another doubling by the end of 2028.
"Our strong and long-standing collaboration with NVIDIA has continued to develop in the area of high-performance IC package substrates," said Koji Kawashima, president and chief executive officer at IBIDEN. "Through the expansion of our Ono Plant, we will continue to strengthen our production capabilities and meet growing demand."
"Our work with NVIDIA demonstrates the value of close collaboration between chip design and semiconductor testing," said Gauss Chang, president at KYEC. "Expanding our testing operations into the United States builds on that relationship and brings our capabilities closer to NVIDIA's growing U.S. manufacturing supply chain."
"As AI reshapes industries and societies around the world, trusted partnerships and supply chain collaboration have never been more important," said SC Chien, chairman of Unimicron. "The advanced substrate capacity investment underscores the strength of our partnership with NVIDIA and our shared commitment to support the rapid growth of AI infrastructure. By investing in advanced substrate technologies and manufacturing capabilities, Unimicron is well-positioned to help customers unlock new opportunities and share in the tremendous growth of the AI era."

articles.title: Quantum error correction ushers quantum into the data center - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Quantum computing drops its decade-away tag as error rates fall 200-fold in two years
Quantum computing is shedding its reputation as speculative as gains in quantum error correction turn fragile machines into reliable ones. For the supercomputing community, which now measures data centers in gigawatts of power, the more pressing question is how quantum fits beside the processors already on the floor.
For years, the field faced a trade-off between speed and reliability, because correcting errors inside a quantum computer slowed it down. That trade-off is fading fast, according to Rajeeb Hazra (pictured), chief executive officer of Quantinuum Inc., which listed on the Nasdaq in June.
“We are now at a stage in 2026 where we have the ability to have tremendous amounts of computation at a very high reliability rate,” Hazra said. “Just two weeks ago, we announced we were doing up to a million operations with five errors. To put it in contrast, just two years ago, we were trying to do 1,000 operations with one error. That’s how fast it is.”
Hazra spoke with theCUBE Research’s John Furrier and Gemma Allen at SC26, during an exclusive broadcast on theCUBE, SiliconANGLE Media’s livestreaming studio. They discussed advances in quantum error correction and how AI and quantum computing work in tandem. (* Disclosure below.)
Quantum error correction opens a path for AI
Quantinuum’s 100-qubit Helios system recently set an error-correction record, reaching logical fidelity equivalent to five errors per million operations. The company builds the full stack, from hardware to developer tools, so customers can model problems such as how a drug ages and loses potency, Hazra explained. That positions quantum less as a rival to AI than as a tool AI will lean on for accurate simulation.
“We see AI and quantum working in tandem, or rather AI using quantum computers,” Hazra said. “I don’t think it’s people using quantum computers; it’s AI programming quantum computers to get the data they need to do what AI does best, which is reasoning and prediction.”
Two cloud service providers have already struck deals with Quantinuum, and most of its use-case customers are commercial companies in pharma, energy, chemicals and financial services, Hazra explained. With quantum error correction maturing, the payoff lies in designing materials that release medicine only where the body needs it.
“My view is in five to seven years max, you’re not going to get a prescription for amoxicillin,” Hazra said. “You’re going to get a sheet of paper that basically says this is your pathology. It’ll get matched up at CVS Pharmacy with the available proteins, if you will, and you will get your personalized medicine.”

articles.title: Google alerta: era de ataques cibernéticos autônomos já começou • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Google alerta: era de ataques cibernéticos autônomos já começou
Relatório de segurança identificou sistemas de IA que encontram falhas e criam ataques sem intervenção humana.
A era dos ataques cibernéticos autônomos já começou, segundo o Google. Em um novo relatório de segurança, a empresa afirma que criminosos estão utilizando agentes de inteligência artificial capazes de identificar vulnerabilidades em programas, desenvolver códigos maliciosos e executar ataques sem depender de comandos humanos.
O alerta foi divulgado pelo Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) na segunda-feira (16/11). O grupo identificou uma evolução no uso de IA por hackers, que passaram de consultas a chatbots para sistemas capazes de coordenar diferentes etapas de uma invasão.
Para o Google, a velocidade dessas ferramentas representa um desafio para equipes de segurança que ainda dependem de análises e respostas manuais. Uma das descobertas envolve um sistema chamado exploit_agent, encontrado pelos pesquisadores em um servidor de testes exposto na internet. A ferramenta utilizava diferentes modelos de IA para analisar atualizações de softwares e identificar possíveis vulnerabilidades.
Na prática, o sistema comparava versões antigas e atualizadas dos programas para descobrir quais falhas haviam sido corrigidas. A partir dessas informações, criava códigos para explorar as brechas e executava testes automaticamente, sem exigir aprovação humana a cada etapa. O Google também encontrou dados extraídos de vítimas e ferramentas que poderiam ser utilizadas após a invasão.
Os indícios apontam para interesse em sites franceses dos setores de mídia, entretenimento e educação. O relatório também cita as ferramentas CAIRN e PentAGI, que coordenam diferentes agentes de IA. Segundo o Google, elas já foram identificadas em atividades de invasão e busca por vulnerabilidades nos Estados Unidos e na Ásia.
O avanço representa uma mudança em relação aos malwares com IA identificados anteriormente pelo Google. Na ocasião, especialistas apontaram limitações nas primeiras tentativas de usar modelos generativos para modificar códigos maliciosos. Agora, a preocupação é que agentes consigam reduzir o intervalo entre a divulgação de uma vulnerabilidade e a sua exploração por criminosos.
Para enfrentar as novas ameaças, o Google está ampliando o uso de ferramentas automatizadas de segurança visando identificar riscos e acelerar a correção de falhas. A ideia é permitir que sistemas de defesa analisem programas, priorizem vulnerabilidades e respondam a incidentes em uma velocidade próxima à dos ataques automatizados.
O tema já havia aparecido em uma investigação anterior. Em maio, o Google afirmou ter bloqueado uma tentativa de ataque desenvolvida com auxílio de IA. Outras empresas também identificaram o uso da tecnologia em ataques reais. A Anthropic relatou uma campanha envolvendo o Claude, na qual criminosos teriam automatizado grande parte das operações contra organizações de diferentes países.
Apesar dos avanços, o relatório do Google ressalta que as ferramentas autônomas ainda apresentam limitações e podem produzir códigos ineficazes, cometer erros e deixar rastros que facilitam a identificação das invasões. Ainda assim, a capacidade de executar mais ataques em menos tempo reforça a importância de corrigir vulnerabilidades rapidamente.

articles.title: Android 17 : Google va enfin empêcher les applis indiscrètes de fouiller dans votre téléphone
articles.text:
Dès le 27 janvier 2027, Google Play demandera aux développeurs de justifier les accès les plus étendus à votre localisation. Le carnet d’adresses et le réseau local sont eux aussi concernés par ce tour de vis.
Google va demander aux développeurs pourquoi leurs applis ont besoin de vous localiser avec précision tout au long d’un trajet, d’une séance de sport ou de toute autre activité qui exige un suivi. Dès le 27 janvier 2027, les développeurs d'applis Android devront justifier les accès étendus à votre localisation précise dans la Play Console. Les applications qui ciblent Android 17 ou une version ultérieure devront, pour les besoins ponctuels de position précise, passer par le bouton de localisation du système, qui limite l’accès à la session en cours.
Un bouton pour partager sa position le temps d’une session
Le 27 janvier 2027, le bouton de localisation deviendra obligatoire pour les applications du Play Store qui ciblent Android 17 (API 37) ou une version ultérieure et n’ont besoin d’une position précise que ponctuellement. Vous pourrez, par exemple, appuyer dessus pour renseigner une adresse de livraison. L’application recevra alors votre position exacte pour la session en cours. Le développeur devra déclarer l’indicateur onlyForLocationButton dans le manifeste de l’application.
Une application de navigation, qui doit actualiser votre position tout au long du trajet, pourra toujours demander l’autorisation standard ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION. Son développeur devra justifier dans la Play Console pourquoi la position approximative et le bouton ne suffisent pas à une fonction essentielle de l’application. Google examinera cette justification, tandis que vous garderez la main sur l’autorisation demandée sur votre téléphone.
Votre carnet d’adresses, contact par contact
Le même jour, Google Play limitera l’accès à l’ensemble du répertoire. Une application qui vous propose d’inviter un ami pourra passer par le sélecteur de contacts d’Android qui ne lui transmettra que les informations que vous choisissez de partager. Pour continuer à appeler READ_CONTACTS, les développeurs d’applications ciblant Android 17 ou une version ultérieure devront démontrer que ce sélecteur ne suffit pas à une fonction essentielle.
En avril prochain, Google s’intéressera à ce que les applications peuvent faire à la demande d’un agent IA. L’API AppFunctions permet par exemple à un assistant d’appeler une fonction de recherche dans une application à votre place. À compter du 14 avril 2027, les noms, paramètres et descriptions exposés à l’agent devront correspondre au comportement réel de ces fonctions. Le règlement interdira aussi de s’en servir pour tromper ou manipuler un agent, contourner ses protections ou perturber le fonctionnement d’autres applications.
En août, Google Play encadrera aussi l’accès au réseau local
Une application qui accède au réseau local peut y découvrir bien plus que le téléviseur auquel vous voulez envoyer une vidéo. Selon les équipements présents sur votre Wi-Fi, elle peut aussi repérer une console ou des caméras connectées. Avec Android 17, les applications qui ciblent cette version doivent obtenir l’autorisation ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK pour accéder directement au réseau ou passer par un sélecteur du système pour dialoguer avec l’appareil de votre choix.
Le 25 août 2027, Google Play ajoutera une exigence à cette protection d’Android. Pour demander ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK, les développeurs d'applications pour Android 17 ou une version ultérieure devront expliquer dans la Play Console pourquoi les sélecteurs ne couvrent pas leurs besoins. Le même jour, Google soumettra à déclaration l’autorisation MANAGE_CONTACTS pour les applications qui ciblent Android 18 (API 38) ou une version ultérieure et ont besoin de gérer le répertoire. Pour un simple ajout ou une modification de fiche contact, les applications devront s’en tenir aux actions système ACTION_INSERT et ACTION_EDIT.
Un peu de ménage dans les autorisations d’Android ne fera pas de mal. Après tout, inviter un ami dans une appli ne devrait pas obliger à partager tout son carnet d’adresses.
Source : Google via Heise

articles.title: NASA's Voyager 1 reaches a distance of one light-day from Earth
articles.text:
In a nutshell: NASA's Voyager 1 has become the first human-made object to travel one light-day from Earth. The milestone occurred on November 18 at 5:16:07 a.m. Eastern time, roughly nine years before its twin spacecraft, Voyager 2, will achieve the same feat.
One "day" might not sound like a lot of time or distance, and in the vast emptiness of space, where everything is so far apart, it really isn't. Rather than using familiar measurements such as miles or kilometers, distances in space are often described in terms of how light travels.
Light moves through space at approximately 186,000 miles per second, and nothing travels faster. The Moon, for reference, is roughly 238,855 miles from Earth on average, and it takes light about 1.3 seconds to travel that distance. At 93 million miles away, sunlight takes about eight minutes and 20 seconds to reach our planet. Astronomers also use the latter, called an astronomical unit (or AU for short), as a unit of length in space.
As you might have guessed, a light-day is the distance light travels in 24 hours: 16,094,799,096 miles (25,902,068,356 kilometers), to be exact. A light-year, by comparison, is roughly 5.88 trillion miles.
NASA launched the two Voyager probes in 1977 to study planets in the outskirts of our solar system, including gas giants Jupiter and Saturn. Voyager 1, which lifted off on September 5, completed its planetary objectives and entered into an extended mission phase in 1980. Voyager 2 launched a couple of weeks earlier on August 20.
Voyager 1 eventually became the first human-made object to reach interstellar space in 2012, with Voyager 2 following suit in 2018. To date, these are the only two spacecraft to have ever achieved this milestone.
To reiterate, both probes have been careening through space since the mid-70s, and only just now has one made it a single light-day from Earth. And to think, some objects in the universe are many billions of light-years away. That truly is absolutely mind-blowing.

articles.title: Reson8 releases Rumble-2-Flash speech model as a free open-weights download - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Reson8 releases Rumble-2-Flash speech model as a free open-weights download
Amsterdam-based speech recognition startup Resonate Labs B.V. today released its Rumble-2-Flash transcription model as a free download with open weights.
Designed for fast transcription of prerecorded audio, the 500 million-parameter model supports more than 40 languages. Reson8 is pitching the release at developers and researchers who need speech recognition built for languages other than English.
According to the company, the leading speech models are trained primarily on English, even though only about one in 20 people speak it as a first language. Specialist terms such as medication names are where accuracy is said to fall furthest once speech moves outside English. Reson8’s models are said to be in production use for meeting notetakers, artificial intelligence receptionists, customer support voice agents, medical transcription and captioning.
“Generic speech models are built for English and make noticeably more mistakes in other languages,” said co-founder and Chief Executive Raoul Ritter, who started the company with Thomas Kluiters and Jarno Verhagen. “Languages like Dutch, Swedish and German are spoken by millions, yet they’re an afterthought.”
Reson8 describes Rumble-2-Flash as one of the smallest models on Hugging Face Inc.’s Open ASR Leaderboard. In the company’s own runs of the leaderboard’s multilingual tests, the model averaged a word error rate of 7.09% across seven languages, including German, French and Dutch. Its average error rate in English is claimed to be about 5%.
On a separate test covering 10 lower-resource languages such as Maltese and Basque, Rumble-2-Flash is said to have posted a mean word error rate of 17.6%. OpenAI Group PBC’s Whisper Large V3 had a mean word error rate of 39.82% on the same test, according to Reson8.
Beyond benchmark sets, Reson8’s models are said to be trained for noisy settings, including phone-line audio. The real world “doesn’t happen in a recording studio,” said Kluiters, the company’s head of AI.
Today’s open-weights release follows the model’s Nov. 3 debut in Reson8’s application programming interface, a week before the company launched its flagship Rumble-2 model. Custom vocabulary support, which lets customers add up to 50,000 terms as text without fine-tuning, remains exclusive to Rumble-2.
Hosted on the company’s own graphics processing units in the Netherlands, Reson8’s service is said to retain no audio or transcripts. The company also claims ISO 27001 certification and compliance with the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation and the bloc’s AI Act.
Available free under an Apache 2.0 license, Rumble-2-Flash can also be accessed through Reson8’s API at prices starting from €0.01 ($0.001) per hour of audio.
Reson8 raised €5 million ($5.5 million) in pre-seed funding in March. Balderton Capital led the round, with NP-Hard Ventures also participating. Speech is “quickly becoming a default interface across software,” according to James Wise, a partner at Balderton.

articles.title: Vous utilisez l'un des 20 pires mots de passe de France ? Changez-le immédiatement
articles.text:
Comme chaque année, NordPass dévoile le classement des mots de passe les plus utilisés dans le monde. Pour cette huitième édition, le gestionnaire de mots de passe édité par Nord Security a analysé, avec des chercheurs indépendants, « les récentes fuites de données rendues publiques et les référentiels du dark web ». Les chercheurs se sont concentrés sur les mots de passe exposés entre septembre 2025 et septembre 2026, dans 44 pays.
À lire aussi : Fuites de données – la France sort du top 3 mondial, mais 18 comptes sont encore piratés chaque minute
Les 20 mots de passe les plus utilisés au monde
Sans surprise, « 123456 » reste le mot de passe le plus répandu sur la planète. D’après NordPass, il a été repéré plus de 7,2 millions de fois dans les fuites de données. Pour rappel, ce mot de passe est aussi répandu que dangereux. Récemment, un pirate s’est d’ailleurs introduit dans le registre central des personnes du Danemark grâce au mot de passe « 123456 ». En exploitant la négligence d’un employé, le pirate s’est emparé des données de millions de Danois.
- 123456
- admin
- 12345678
- 123456789
- 1234
- 12345
- password
- Aa123456
- Pass@123
- 1234567890
- admin123
- 123123
- 1234567
- 12345678910
- 111111
- Password
- pass1111
- Pass@1234
- Pass@12345
- Admin@123
Cette année, les caractères spéciaux gagnent du terrain. En effet, 39 mots de passe du classement mondial en contiennent, contre 32 l’an dernier, ce qui cadre avec les pratiques recommandées en matière de cybersécurité. Néanmoins, la plupart des restent encore trop simples, comme « P@ssw0rd » ou « Admin@123 ».
« Si vous devez créer un mot de passe non aléatoire, par exemple un mot de passe maître, mieux vaut opter pour une phrase de passe longue composée de deux ou trois mots plutôt que pour un mot de passe court et commun comportant des caractères spéciaux », conseille Karolis Arbaciauskas, responsable produit chez NordPass.
Les chercheurs ont aussi repéré des mots de passe par défaut de routeurs, comme « ALC#FGU » et « adminHW ». Ils sont si répandus qu’ils figurent dans le classement mondial des mots de passe les plus compromis. Autrement dit, d’innombrables box Internet et objets connectés restent exposés aux cyberattaques
Les 20 pires mots de passe de France
En France, « 123456 » reprend la tête du classement. L’an dernier, il avait été détrôné par « admin », qui se contente cette fois de la deuxième place du top français. On trouve aussi plusieurs variantes liées au clavier AZERTY, avec « azerty », « azertyuiop » et « Azerty123 ». On note aussi des choix plus personnels, comme « bebe2012 », « loulou », ou « Marseille13 ».
- 123456
- admin
- password
- 123456789
- 12345678
- azerty
- 1234
- Password
- azertyuiop
- azerty123
- bebe2012
- Azerty123
- 8888
- pass1111
- Marseille13
- 12345
- motdepasse
- 1234567
- Mot de passe
- loulou
De « metallica » à « skibiditoilet »
Cette année, NordPass s’est aussi intéressé à l’influence de la culture pop sur nos mots de passe. Chaque époque laisse son empreinte sur les codes employés par les internautes, comme « metallica » et « corleone13 » pour les années 80 et 90, « sasuke » et « eminem2004 » pour les années 2000, « minecraft » et « neymar10 » pour les années 2010, ou encore « skibiditoilet » et « squidgamethebest » pour la décennie actuelle.
« Les mots de passe inspirés de la culture pop nous rappellent que ce que l’on aime nous rend prévisibles. Les pirates n’ont pas besoin de vous connaître personnellement : il leur suffit de connaître vos centres d’intérêt », met en garde Karolis Arbaciauskas, ajoutant que le nom d’un groupe préféré associé à une année de naissance peut ainsi être « piraté en moins d’une seconde ».
On vous recommande évidemment de ne jamais vous servir d’un des mots de passe épinglés ci-dessus. Plus un mot de passe est répandu, plus les pirates peuvent le deviner en très peu de temps. La meilleure défense contre les cyberattaques consiste à utiliser des mots de passe longs, d’au moins 14 caractères, et différents pour chacun de vos comptes. Pensez également à activer la double authentification dès que celle-ci est disponible. Ce mécanisme de sécurité bloque les pirates, même si votre mot de passe et votre nom d’utilisateur ont été compromis.

articles.title: One UI 9.5 est là : découvrez les nouveautés majeures de la prochaine mise à jour des Samsung Galaxy
articles.text:
One UI 9.5 officialisée : Samsung lance la bêta sur les Galaxy S26, voici toutes les nouveautés majeures à retenir
Samsung lance la bêta de One UI 9.5 sur ses Galaxy S26, avec une belle liste de nouveautés pour améliorer ses smartphones.
Samsung vient de donner le coup d’envoi officiel de One UI 9.5 ce 18 novembre 2026 en déployant la première bêta de sa future mise à jour majeure sur les Galaxy S26. En attendant la sortie de la version stable début 2027 avec le lancement des futurs Galaxy S27, plusieurs fonctions font déjà parler d’elles, dont une qui permet enfin de verrouiller individuellement ses applications.
La prochaine mise à jour des Samsung Galaxy révèle de belles surprises
La première nouveauté à retenir de One UI 9.5 avec le déploiement de cette bêta est attendue de longue date : le verrouillage natif des applications. Contrairement au Dossier sécurisé qui impose de dupliquer chaque logiciel dans un espace isolé, cette fonction protège directement vos applications existantes par empreinte digitale, reconnaissance faciale, code PIN ou schéma. À noter que lorsqu’une application est verrouillée, ses notifications sont masquées et ses widgets disparaissent de l’écran d’accueil, même si vous prêtez votre téléphone déverrouillé.
Sur le Galaxy S26 Ultra, cette protection s’associe à un mode Privacy Display bien plus précis. L’écran de confidentialité s’active désormais automatiquement dans des zones sensibles, comme les applications verrouillées, les albums privés de la Galerie, le mode Secret du navigateur Samsung ou les notes protégées, ainsi que dans les aperçus de notifications.
L’application Appareil photo gagne au passage en ergonomie, avec des raccourcis personnalisables autour du déclencheur, comme l’a fait Apple avec la sortie d’iOS 27, ainsi que des modes Pro et Pro Vidéo enrichis de préréglages intégrés.
Parmi les autres ajouts notables de One UI 9.5, on retrouve l’intégration d’un effet de profondeur animé sur l’écran de verrouillage selon l’inclinaison du smartphone, des raccourcis flottants d’accessibilité, le contrôle du volume des aides auditives directement dans le volet de notifications, ainsi que le suivi mondial des médicaments et un journal de pleine conscience dans Samsung Health.
Pour l’heure, cette mise à jour basée sur Android 17 pèse environ 3,5 Go et reste réservée aux utilisateurs inscrits au programme bêta de Samsung. Pour rappel, seuls six pays sont éligibles : l’Allemagne, la Corée du Sud, les États-Unis, l’Inde, la Pologne et le Royaume-Uni.

articles.title: L’agent IA de Gemini peut désormais appeler le garagiste et prendre rendez-vous à votre place
articles.text:
Google ouvre gratuitement l’accès à son agent Gemini dans six pays, où il peut mener des recherches ou préparer votre briefing du matin en arrière-plan. Aux États-Unis, le déploiement va plus loin avec la possibilité de passer des appels et de régler des achats via Google Pay.
Un voyant s’allume sur le tableau de bord. Il faut trouver un garage près de chez vous, appeler, patienter, puis vérifier que le créneau proposé colle avec votre agenda. C’est cette petite corvée que Josh Woodward, responsable de l’application Gemini, dit avoir confiée à l’IA. Dans le récit publié par Google, Gemini a repéré deux garages sur Maps, les a appelés en parallèle en se présentant comme une IA, puis a inscrit le rendez-vous dans Google Agenda. Le tout en moins de cinq minutes, selon Woodward.
Spark change de nom et devient accessible sans abonnement
Présenté en mai sous le nom de Gemini Spark, l’agent s’appelle désormais « Tasks in Gemini », à ne pas confondre avec l’application Google Tasks. Un bouton sur l’écran d’accueil permet de basculer du chat vers le mode Tâches. Une fois la demande envoyée, on peut passer à autre chose. Gemini poursuit le travail en arrière-plan, accepte de nouvelles consignes en cours de route et vous prévient quand le résultat est prêt.
L’intérêt du mode Tâches se voit aussi dans les routines. Vous pouvez demander à Gemini de croiser chaque matin vos e-mails et votre agenda pour faire ressortir ce qui mérite votre attention avant la première réunion. L’agent peut également préparer un itinéraire de voyage ou prendre en charge une recherche qui demande plusieurs étapes.
Le déploiement gratuit a commencé le 17 novembre aux États-Unis, au Canada, en Australie, en Inde, au Japon et en Corée du Sud. L’agent tourne sur Gemini 4 Hydrogen, le modèle que Google vient aussi d’intégrer à son moteur de recherche. Comme c’est souvent le cas lorsqu’il s’agit d’intelligence artificielle, aucune date n’a été annoncée pour la France et il faudra sûrement attendre plusieurs mois avant de voir apparaître cette fonction chez nous.
Jusqu’où peut-on laisser Gemini agir ?
Aux États-Unis, il est aussi possible de confier une tâche à Gemini par message ou en lui transférant un e-mail. Google donne l’exemple de messages de l’école dont l’agent récupère les dates pour les ajouter au calendrier familial. The Verge relève que Gemini peut aussi se connecter à certains sites via le gestionnaire de mots de passe de Google.
Pour les achats, l’utilisateur peut fixer un plafond de dépenses. Google indique que l’agent est conçu pour demander une validation avant de passer commande, avec la possibilité de donner son accord à l’avance. Le degré d’autonomie dépend aussi du site. Dans l’exemple des courses chez Instacart, Gemini ajoute les produits demandés au panier, puis rend la main à l’utilisateur pour terminer la commande.
Google affirme que chaque compte dispose d’un environnement isolé où l’agent exécute ses tâches. Les applications connectées peuvent être retirées dans les réglages, et les commerces peuvent refuser les appels automatisés. Si votre garage les accepte, Gemini pourra patienter à votre place. Pour le prix de la révision, vous aurez encore votre mot à dire.

articles.title: GTA 6: cuándo va a salir oficialmente y a qué hora
articles.text:
GTA 6 se estrenará oficialmente el jueves 19 de noviembre de 2026 en PlayStation 5 y Xbox Series X|S, con un desbloqueo a las 00:00 según la hora local de cada región. Esto hará que el lanzamiento de Grand Theft Auto VI ocurra de forma escalonada y que algunos mercados de Oceanía accedan antes que América Latina y Europa.
La fecha y la hora de salida importan porque el videojuego requiere hasta 212 GB libres en la unidad SSD y llegará mediante un código de descarga, incluso en las copias físicas. Quienes no hayan realizado la predescarga tendrán que completar la instalación antes de recorrer Leonida y Vice City.
GTA 6 se habilita el 19 de noviembre a las 00:00 en cada país
Rockstar Games eligió un lanzamiento regional, en lugar de activar el juego de manera simultánea en todo el mundo. Por eso, la disponibilidad avanza a medida que cada país llega al jueves 19 de noviembre de 2026.
En América Latina, GTA 6 se habilitará a las 00:00 de la hora local de la tienda digital de cada país. El criterio se aplicará en Argentina, Colombia, Chile, México y Perú, donde los jugadores tendrán acceso al comenzar el jueves.
En España y el resto de Europa, el juego también se desbloqueará a medianoche según la hora local. La diferencia entre los husos horarios hará que el estreno ocurra antes en Europa que en gran parte de América Latina.
Los jugadores deben revisar la hora que indiquen PlayStation Store o Microsoft Store en su consola. La región configurada en la tienda digital determina el momento en que se activa la descarga completa y se puede iniciar la partida.
Oceanía y Asia tendrán acceso antes que América Latina
Los primeros mercados que recibirán Grand Theft Auto VI serán los ubicados en los husos horarios más adelantados. Nueva Zelanda y Fiyi podrán jugar antes de que llegue el 19 de noviembre a países como Colombia, Argentina o México.
Después se habilitará en Australia, con ciudades como Sídney y Melbourne entre los primeros grandes mercados. Más tarde, el acceso llegará a Asia Oriental, con países como Japón y Corea del Sur.
Este sistema explica por qué, mientras en América Latina aún transcurra el miércoles 18 de noviembre, algunos jugadores de Oceanía ya podrán entrar al videojuego. La salida oficial mantiene la misma fecha global, aunque la llegada práctica se produce en momentos distintos según el territorio.
En Xbox Series X|S, algunos usuarios modifican la región de la consola para utilizar el llamado “truco de Nueva Zelanda”. En PlayStation 5, esta posibilidad requiere adquirir el juego desde una cuenta secundaria creada para esa región.
Estados Unidos podrá jugar desde la noche del miércoles 18
En Estados Unidos, las tiendas digitales tomarán como referencia la Hora del Este. Esto permitirá que los jugadores de las regiones central, de montaña y del Pacífico accedan antes de su medianoche local.
Los horarios previstos son:
- Hora del Este, como Miami y Nueva York: jueves 19 de noviembre a las 00:00.
- Hora Central, como Chicago y Houston: miércoles 18 de noviembre a las 23:00.
- Hora de la Montaña, como Denver: miércoles 18 de noviembre a las 22:00.
- Hora del Pacífico, como Los Ángeles: miércoles 18 de noviembre a las 21:00.
La diferencia no implica una edición especial ni un acceso anticipado oficial. Es el resultado de la referencia horaria elegida para las tiendas digitales de Estados Unidos.
La predescarga exige hasta 212 GB de almacenamiento
La predescarga de GTA 6 está disponible desde el 10 de noviembre para quienes reservaron la edición digital. En PlayStation 5, se inicia desde la biblioteca o desde PlayStation Store. En Xbox Series X|S, se activa desde Xbox Store después de completar la reserva.
El juego requerirá hasta 212 GB de espacio libre en la consola. Las copias físicas tampoco incluirán un disco: la caja contendrá un código de descarga. Por tanto, será necesaria una conexión a internet y suficiente almacenamiento, sin importar la edición elegida.
El lanzamiento inicial estará limitado a PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X y Xbox Series S. No habrá una versión para PC el día del estreno y Rockstar Games no anunció una fecha para computadoras. Los usuarios de Xbox One podrán acceder mediante Xbox Cloud Gaming con la configuración gráfica de Xbox Series S.

articles.title: Como baixar vídeos de qualquer site • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Como baixar vídeos de qualquer site
Fazer download de vídeos de sites da internet permite criar uma biblioteca offline no seu dispositivo, ficando menos dependente de conexões
Você pode guardar suas mídias favoritas offline ao utilizar ferramentas especializadas para baixar vídeo de um site. Hoje, existem diferentes meios de fazer download de vídeo de qualquer site diretamente para seu dispositivo e salvar o conteúdo da internet.
Entre as alternativas mais populares, vale instalar uma extensão para baixar vídeos diretamente no navegador Google Chrome ou utilizar sites conversores online. Contudo, barreiras como direitos autorais protegidos, criptografia de streaming e players restritos podem impedir a captura do arquivo.
A seguir, o Tecnoblog te explica como baixar vídeo de qualquer site pelo PC.
Usar uma extensão para baixar vídeos no navegador Chrome facilita o download de qualquer mídia direto no computador. Confira o passo a passo para utilizar a ferramenta 4Saved no PC.
Abra o Google Chrome no computador e visite a loja de extensões do navegador: chromewebstore.google.com.
Use a barra de pesquisa no topo da página e digite “4Saved” para encontrar a extensão para baixar vídeos compatível com o Google Chrome.
Clique no botão azul “Usar no Chrome” no canto direito e, na janela pop-up, selecione “Adicionar extensão” para concluir a instalação.
Acesse a página onde está o arquivo que deseja salvar e dê o play para que o 4Saved identifique o fluxo de mídias disponível para baixar vídeo de um site.
Clique no ícone do 4Saved, ícone preto e amarelo ao lado da barra de endereço, e selecione a opção com seta para baixo para fazer o download da mídia.
Importante: vídeos no formato .mp4 são baixados automaticamente e salvos na pasta “Downloads” do PC. Em outros formatos, será necessário seguir para o passo seguinte do guia.
Caso o arquivo esteja no formato .m3u8, uma nova aba será aberta. Aguarde o carregamento atingir 100% e clique no botão “Save” para baixar o vídeo do site.
Você também pode utilizar ferramentas online direto no navegador como uma opção prática para fazer download de vídeo de qualquer site sem instalar programas. Confira como usar o SnapWC para baixar vídeo de qualquer site pelo PC:
Use o navegador do dispositivo para acessar snapwc.com. Esta página permite baixar vídeo pelo link de qualquer página na web.
Copie o endereço da página onde está o arquivo, cole no campo central e clique em “Obter links de download” para o sistema extrair o vídeo.
Na seção “Vídeo”, selecione a qualidade e o formato do arquivo que será baixado e clique no botão de seta para baixo para iniciar a conversão.
Aguarde a exibição de um breve anúncio na nova janela, retorne à aba anterior para liberar o botão final e conclua o processo para baixar o vídeo de um site.
Sim, o método via link em plataforma web permite fazer o download de vídeo de qualquer site diretamente pelo celular, sem precisar instalar aplicativos extras. Assim como no PC, basta copiar o endereço da página com a mídia e colar no site conversor usando o próprio navegador do aparelho.
Durante o processo, pode ser necessário ajustar as permissões de segurança e downloads nas configurações do navegador para autorizar o salvamento de conteúdo de terceiros.
Existem algumas barreiras técnicas e de segurança que podem impedir você de baixar vídeo de qualquer site, mesmo usando extensões ou plataformas de conversão. Confira os principais motivos que bloqueiam a captura e o salvamento desses arquivos:
Sim, as extensões e sites conversores costumam funcionar com redes sociais, mas o ideal é dar preferência às funções nativas para baixar vídeos do Instagram ou fazer download de vídeos do TikTok. Quando o criador de conteúdo deixa essa permissão ativa, você salva o arquivo original direto no dispositivo sem depender de plataformas externas.
Já a forma oficial de assistir no modo offline do YouTube exige uma assinatura do plano YouTube Premium. Caso você queira ter uma cópia dos arquivos, é necessário usar as ferramentas de terceiros para baixar os vídeos do YouTube.
Baixar vídeo de qualquer site sem permissão traz riscos legais, pois pode violar direitos autorais e os termos de uso das plataformas, mesmo para consumo próprio. Quebrar travas digitais de serviços de assinatura ou redistribuir o material agrava a situação, gerando desde o banimento da sua conta até processos judiciais.
Na prática, o maior perigo está no uso de sites conversores e extensões de navegador pouco confiáveis. Essas plataformas podem esconder anúncios maliciosos, golpes de phishing e softwares espiões capazes de roubar senhas e comprometer a segurança do seu dispositivo.

articles.title: AMD’s Twitter brag that it ‘loves gamers’ met with savage Community Note
articles.text:
AMD’s Twitter brag that it ‘loves gamers’ met with savage Community Note — post met with backlash over the company’s pivot to AI
The company said it 'values its interactions with gamers above all else'
AMD Japan's X account has been met with sharp reproach after claiming the company loves gamers and values its interactions with gamers above all else, with commenters and even a community note expressing dissent at the sentiment, owing to AMD's comments on its "data center-first" ethos and a commitment to AI that has driven the price of consumer PC gaming up to nearly unaffordable levels.
Quoting a Tom's Hardware post on the X social network discussing CEO Dr. Lisa Su meeting gamers and autographing a GPU, the AMD Japan account was quick to seize the moment. "AMD values its interactions with gamers above all else," the post read, but it was met with a stark reminder that gamers don't feel the same way. The post soon received a new community note that pointed out that AMD's own CEO doesn't agree. In fact, Su was quoted as saying that AMD is now "a data center-first company," with the note also pointing to the fact that AMD's data center revenue increased 97% year-over-year, as per its Q3 2026 earnings report. That equates to around $8.5 billion in revenue, while client and gaming revenue fell 8% to $3.7 billion. Gaming alone was down 40%.
At the time, Su said that AMD expected its server revenue to double year over year in 2027, with its data center AI revenue growing at an even faster rate. "As a result, we expect data center to be more than eighty percent of our total revenue in 2027 and to drive the majority of our revenue and earnings growth," the CEO said during the company's earnings call.
By comparison, the same call heard Su say that, in 2027, AMD was "planning for PC market unit shipments to decline by a double-digit percentage." With this all in mind, it's perhaps no surprise that the AMD Japan X account stirred such a strong response from gamers who feel that AMD has left them behind in search of a more lucrative data center market. AMD is certainly not alone in that regard. Nvidia, once the darling of the PC component enthusiast, is now focused on AI data center components instead. The company's high-performance AI chips are so capable that they're export-controlled, something that, among other reasons, will put former CEO Jensen Huang in front of a House Foreign Affairs panel in December.
As for AMD, its ill-timed, misjudged X post ended with "AMD loves gamers." Gamers would appear to disagree.
Download the Tom's Hardware app for up-to-the-minute updates on iOS and Android. Also follow Tom's Hardware on Google News, or add us as a preferred source, to get our latest news, analysis, & reviews in your feeds.
Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
Oliver Haslam has written about technology of all shapes and sizes for over 15 years, both online and in print. He's fascinated by how personal computing continues to change as tower PCs give way to foldable phones and beyond.

articles.title: Google et Amazon vont détenir près d'un tiers d'Anthropic
articles.text:
Amazon (14,7 %) et Google (13,7%) détiendront ensemble environ 28 % d’Anthropic après son introduction en Bourse, selon de nouveaux documents déposés auprès de la SEC. Une partie de ces titres vient de billets convertibles, et aucun ne donne de droit de vote. Anthropic et ses cofondateurs pourraient lever jusqu’à 64,4 milliards de dollars.
Anthropic doit fixer le prix de son action ce mercredi 18 novembre, avant une cotation jeudi sur le Nasdaq sous le symbole “ANT”. Les derniers documents d’Anthropic, repris par Bloomberg, précisent ce que deux de ses fournisseurs cloud vont détenir.
Actions sans vote et billets convertibles : comment Amazon et Google entrent au capital
Amazon et Google passent par une catégorie spéciale d’actions, la classe N. Ces titres ne donnent pas de voix en assemblée, seulement droit à d’éventuels dividendes. Amazon en recevra 1,92 milliard (34 % de la classe), soit 14,7 % d’Anthropic. Google en aura 1,79 milliard (32 % de la classe). Ses titres viennent à la fois d’une conversion de billets et du placement privé, où il a acheté 135,1 millions d’actions pour environ 10 milliards de dollars. Le poids des fondateurs n’est donc pas touché : Nous rapportions en fin de mois dernier que ces derniers garderaient 50,1 % des voix grâce à une action de classe F unique, détenue par Founder LLC.
Pour Amazon, tout part des investissements de 2023 et 2024. Le groupe a obtenu des billets convertibles, c’est-à-dire des reconnaissances de dette qu’il peut transformer en actions à un prix fixé à l’avance, soit environ 2,09 ou 5,05 dollars selon l’année. En face, la fourchette de l’introduction en Bourse va de 70 à 78 dollars. Amazon n’a converti qu’une partie de ses billets et en garde pour des milliards de dollars. S’il convertissait tout, il détiendrait 23,8 % d’Anthropic. Selon Bloomberg, un plafond de 12 % encadre ces conversions et Amazon a promis de le conserver.
- Excellente compréhension des consignes complexes
- Très bon niveau en rédaction
- Analyse de longs documents efficace
En mars 2025, d’après des documents judiciaires obtenus par le New York Times, Google disposait 14 % d'Anthropic. Le placement privé de 26 milliards de dollars rassemble sept groupes : AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, NVIDIA et TSMC Partners. Google et NVIDIA y mettent chacun 10 milliards, un achat qui n’aura lieu que si l’introduction aboutit. Placement compris, le total devrait dépasser les 75 milliards de dollars levés par SpaceX en juin. En haut de la fourchette, Anthropic serait valorisée environ 1 405 milliards de dollars, sur une base diluée.
Ces trois groupes ne sont pas que des actionnaires. Anthropic décrit Amazon, Google et Microsoft comme à la fois investisseurs, clients, partenaires de distribution et concurrents. Concrètement, une entreprise qui utilise Claude via son compte chez l’un d’eux paie ce fournisseur, qui garde une commission avant de reverser le reste à Anthropic. Ce circuit représente environ 44 % du chiffre d’affaires des trois premiers trimestres de 2026. Anthropic s’est aussi engagée à dépenser plus de 100 milliards de dollars chez AWS d’ici dix ans.

articles.title: 10 polite ways to set boundaries with family and colleagues
articles.text:
10 polite ways to set boundaries with family and colleagues
Discover 10 polite ways to set boundaries with family and colleagues while protecting your time, energy, personal space and emotional well-being.
Setting boundaries is an important part of maintaining healthy relationships, but it is not always easy. Saying no to a family member, declining an extra task at work or asking someone to respect your personal space can sometimes feel uncomfortable. Many people worry that setting boundaries will make them appear rude, selfish or uncooperative.
However, boundaries are not about pushing people away. They help establish mutual respect and make relationships more balanced. Whether you are dealing with family expectations or workplace demands, learning to communicate your limits calmly can protect your time, energy and well-being.
Here are 10 polite ways to set boundaries without creating unnecessary conflict.
1. Say no without giving lengthy explanations
You do not have to justify every decision with a detailed explanation. If a family member asks you to attend an event or a colleague requests help when you are already busy, you can politely decline.
Try saying, "Thank you for asking, but I won't be able to manage it this time." A short and respectful response communicates your decision without making the conversation unnecessarily complicated.
2. Be clear about your availability
Constant calls, messages and last-minute requests can make it difficult to protect your personal time. Let people know when you are available and when you need to focus on other responsibilities.
For example, you could tell a colleague, "I usually respond to work messages during office hours. I'll get back to you tomorrow morning." Similarly, let family members know when you need uninterrupted time for work, studies or rest.
3. Avoid taking responsibility for everyone's emotions
It is natural to care about how others feel, but you cannot make every person happy all the time. Sometimes, people may feel disappointed when you decline a request or express a different opinion.
Instead of changing your decision out of guilt, acknowledge their feelings while maintaining your position. You can say, "I understand that this is important to you, but I still need to make the decision that works for me."
4. Keep work and personal life separate
Workplace communication can easily extend beyond office hours, especially when colleagues expect immediate responses. However, being responsible at work does not mean being available around the clock.
Politely communicate your working hours and avoid responding to non-urgent requests during your personal time. You can say, "I'd be happy to discuss this during working hours tomorrow." This creates a professional boundary without sounding unhelpful.
5. Speak up when someone makes uncomfortable comments
Family gatherings and workplace conversations sometimes involve personal remarks about appearance, relationships, salary or lifestyle choices. Even when people claim they are joking, repeated comments can become uncomfortable.
Instead of ignoring your feelings, communicate your discomfort calmly. Try saying, "I know you may not mean it negatively, but I'd prefer not to discuss this topic." Being respectful does not mean you have to accept every comment.
6. Stop agreeing to tasks beyond your capacity
Taking on every responsibility may make you seem dependable, but it can eventually lead to stress and exhaustion. Before accepting an additional task, consider your existing commitments and available time.
At work, you can say, "I can take this up, but I'll need to revisit the timeline for my current tasks." With family, try saying, "I would like to help, but I already have a few responsibilities to manage today." This communicates your limits while keeping the conversation constructive.
7. Ask for privacy and personal space
Healthy relationships also require respect for individual privacy. Family members may sometimes expect access to personal conversations, belongings or decisions, while colleagues may ask questions that feel too personal.
You can politely communicate what you are comfortable sharing. For example, say, "I'd prefer to keep that matter private" or "I need some time to myself right now." You can value your relationships while maintaining personal space.
8. Avoid discussing sensitive topics when you are uncomfortable
Not every conversation needs to happen immediately. If someone brings up a sensitive subject when you are tired, upset or unprepared, it is reasonable to ask for another time.
Try saying, "I'd rather discuss this when we both have more time" or "I'm not comfortable talking about this right now." This helps prevent emotionally charged conversations and gives everyone an opportunity to communicate more thoughtfully.
9. Be consistent with the boundaries you establish
Setting a boundary once may not be enough if people are used to you always agreeing. They may need time to understand that your response has changed.
For instance, if you have communicated that you cannot take work calls after office hours, try not to repeatedly make exceptions for non-urgent matters. Consistency helps others understand your expectations and reduces confusion over time.
10. Communicate your expectations before problems arise
Boundaries are easier to maintain when people understand your expectations early. Rather than waiting until you feel overwhelmed, have open conversations about your availability, responsibilities and personal preferences.
You might tell your family that you need a specific period for uninterrupted study or let your colleagues know how much time you need to complete an assignment. Clear communication can prevent misunderstandings and make everyday interactions smoother.
Final thoughts
Setting boundaries with family and colleagues does not mean being distant, unkind or difficult to work with. It means understanding your limits and communicating them in a respectful way.
You may not always receive an immediate positive response, and some people may need time to adjust. However, you do not have to abandon your needs simply to avoid disappointing others.
Start with small changes, use calm language and remain consistent. Healthy boundaries allow you to maintain meaningful relationships while making enough room for your own priorities, personal space and well-being.

articles.title: YouTube sait combien de personnes sont en train de regarder la TV, mais on ne sait pas comment
articles.text:
En août dernier, YouTube changeait pour la première fois les règles de la comptabilisation des vues. Depuis, dès qu’une vidéo est lancée, elle est comptée comme une vue. Il y a quelques jours, YouTube a discrètement instauré une nouvelle règle : les vues sur TV vont être démultipliées.
Les vues YouTube sur TV vont parfois compter double, ou triple
Depuis le 16 novembre, YouTube a changé une nouvelle fois de manière de comptabiliser les vues : « nous allons franchir une nouvelle étape dans la mesure de la façon dont les spectateurs regardent vos contenus sur les téléviseurs », peut-on lire sur le forum dédié aux créateurs sur la plateforme. YouTube intègre dans le compteur de vues d’une vidéo les estimations de covisionnage, jusque-là cantonnées dans les statistiques de chaque chaîne YouTube. Autrement dit, lorsque YouTube estimera que plusieurs personnes regardent une même vidéo sur un même téléviseur, ce ne sera plus une seule vue qui sera comptabilisée, mais plusieurs.
YouTube revendique officiellement qu’il s’agit de refléter « plus précisément la façon dont les spectateurs regardent vos contenus. » Mais c’est aussi un moyen de faire gonfler les vues d’une vidéo et ainsi de renforcer son attractivité commerciale ou encore d’encourager les créateurs et les internautes à rester sur la plateforme grâce à cet effet de preuve sociale. Face à des réseaux sociaux comme TikTok ou Instagram, sur lesquels les utilisateurs enchaînent les vidéos et font gonfler les compteurs de vues, YouTube ne semblait plus avoir de choix. D’ailleurs, ce système de covisionnage fonctionne sur tous les formats : vidéos classiques, Shorts et lives.
Comment YouTube estime combien de personnes regardent une vidéo sur un même téléviseur
Pour mesurer les audiences à la télévision, l’organisme Médiamétrie a installé des boîtiers dans quelques milliers de foyers. À la maison, dès que la télévision est allumée, les participants doivent indiquer dessus combien de personnes regardent la télévision. Ce qui n’existe absolument pas sur YouTube, qui est resté durant des années à son compteur de vues.
Dans son communiqué, YouTube indique ne jamais utiliser de caméras, de microphones ou autres capteurs d’appareils pour mesurer ce « covisionnage ». Autrement dit, il n’utilisera pas votre téléviseur ou vos téléphones/tablettes pour vous espionner, de quelque manière que ce soit. Une bonne chose en ces temps où les téléviseurs sont régulièrement accusés d’espionner les téléspectateurs. Non, YouTube a préféré créer un modèle d’estimation avec ses chercheurs. La plateforme s’explique : « notre système analyse des signaux tels que les schémas démographiques, les métadonnées de contenu et les heures de visionnage pour estimer quand plusieurs personnes regardent la télévision ensemble. » Il s’agit donc d’une estimation algorithmique et non pratique : « au petit doigt mouillé » comme diraient certains.

articles.title: La nouvelle manette de 8bitdo copie un peu la GameCube, mais alors juste un peu
articles.text:
La nouvelle manette de 8bitdo copie un peu la GameCube, mais alors juste un peu
Paraît-il que l'imitation est le plus beau des hommages : avec le GC Bluetooth Gamepad, 8bitdo réalise un fac-similé sans-fil et compatible Switch et PC de la manette GameCube.
On savait que 8bitdo était du genre à singer Nintendo pour plusieurs de ses manettes de jeu - avec toujours une distinction et une manière de faire qui les démarquent de la concurrence. La GC Bluetooth Gamepad poursuit cette philosophie en allant piquer la quasi-totalité du design si particulier du pad GameCube.
Disponible à partir du 10 décembre prochain, le GC Bluetooth Gamepad reprend donc les boutons aux formes distinctives du pad GameCube, le petit stick C et le joystick gauche cranté. La silhouette est toutefois légèrement différente, beaucoup plus ramassée, qui évoque la version WaveBird sans-fil de la manette violette qui lui sert de muse.
Modernité oblige, le GC Bluetooth GameCube est compatible avec les interfaces Bluetooth 5 (logique), mais aussi radio 2,4 GHz et filaire via sa prise USB-C. Les joysticks abandonnent les potentiomètres d'autrefois pour la technologie de magnétorésistance tunnel (TMR), des gâchettes à effet Hall et des boutons supplémentaires pour s'accommoder des fonctions de capture d'écran et de menu Home des consoles Switch, Switch 2 et enfin PC. À voir si cette alternative moderne saura trouver écho auprès des nostalgiques.

articles.title: GTA VI logró un puntaje histórico en Metacritic, el sitio que reúne reseñas de críticos de videojuegos
articles.text:
Grand Theft Auto VI alcanzó 99 puntos en Metacritic, una puntuación que lo ubica, de forma provisoria, en la cima histórica del agregador junto con The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. El promedio se formó con 100 reseñas de medios especializados y puede modificarse a medida que se incorporen nuevas críticas.
La marca explica por qué “Metacritic” se convirtió en tendencia en redes sociales antes del lanzamiento del juego, previsto para el 19 de noviembre en PlayStation 5 y Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar Games superó además su mejor registro previo: Grand Theft Auto IV tenía 98 puntos, mientras que Grand Theft Auto V llegó a 97.
Metacritic reúne las críticas profesionales en una sola calificación
Metacritic es un sitio que recopila reseñas de videojuegos, películas, series, discos y programas de televisión publicadas por medios especializados. Para los videojuegos, convierte las calificaciones de cada publicación a una escala sobre 100 y calcula un promedio ponderado llamado Metascore.
La ponderación implica que las reseñas no necesariamente tienen el mismo peso. La plataforma asigna una relevancia diferente a los medios incluidos en su selección, de acuerdo con criterios propios sobre su trayectoria y alcance. El resultado busca reflejar el consenso de la crítica profesional, no la opinión del público.
Por esa razón, el Metascore y la puntuación de usuarios son indicadores separados. El 99 de GTA VI corresponde a las reseñas de críticos; las valoraciones de jugadores todavía no estaban disponibles en la ficha del título. La propia plataforma aclara que los votos de usuarios no forman parte del cálculo del Metascore.
El 99 coloca a GTA VI entre los registros más altos del sitio
La cifra tiene relevancia por su escasez. Un 99 es el puntaje máximo registrado en el ranking histórico de Metacritic y, hasta ahora, solo lo había alcanzado The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, publicado para Nintendo 64 en 1998.
En ese contexto, GTA VI iguala una marca que se mantuvo durante casi tres décadas. También amplía el historial de Rockstar entre los lanzamientos mejor recibidos: GTA IV obtuvo 98, y GTA V, GTA III y Red Dead Redemption 2 se ubicaron en 97 en algunas de sus versiones para consolas.
El dato debe leerse con una salvedad. Metacritic publica puntuaciones por plataforma y los promedios pueden cambiar cuando suma nuevas críticas. La ficha de reseñas de GTA VI en Metacritic indica 99 puntos en PlayStation 5 y clasifica la recepción como “aclamación universal”.
Ranking de los videojuegos con las puntuaciones más altas
El ranking histórico de Metacritic incluye distintas ediciones de un mismo juego según la consola o plataforma. Entre los puntajes más altos figuran los siguientes títulos:
- Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation 5): 99 puntos
- The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Nintendo 64): 99 puntos
- Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 2 (PlayStation): 98 puntos
- Grand Theft Auto IV (Xbox 360): 98 puntos
- SoulCalibur (Dreamcast): 98 puntos
- Grand Theft Auto V (PlayStation 3): 97 puntos
- The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (Nintendo Switch): 97 puntos
- Super Mario Odyssey (Nintendo Switch): 97 puntos
- Red Dead Redemption 2 (Xbox One): 97 puntos
- Metroid Prime (GameCube): 97 puntos
El listado toma las versiones con mayor calificación de cada obra y puede variar por actualizaciones de la base de datos.
La recepción crítica suma presión antes del lanzamiento
El nuevo juego transcurre en el estado ficticio de Leonida y tiene como protagonistas a Jason y Lucia. Su salida llega después de una espera de más de una década desde el lanzamiento de GTA V, uno de los videojuegos más vendidos de la industria.
La puntuación de 99 instala a GTA VI en una comparación directa con títulos de referencia incluso antes de que el público pueda jugarlo y valorar su experiencia. El promedio final dependerá de las reseñas que Metacritic incorpore después del lanzamiento.

articles.title: Flipper One raises more than €10 million on Kickstarter in just 24 hours
articles.text:
Linux Hacking FTW: Earlier this year, Flipper Devices announced a brand-new cyberdeck aimed at power users and hacking enthusiasts. Now that the Flipper One has launched its Kickstarter campaign, customers are pouring millions of dollars into pre-orders. The crowdfunding price is discounted, but quantities are limited, so get yours while you still can.
The Flipper One Kickstarter campaign is now live, and the developers have already raised more than €10,700,000 against an initial funding target of €272,981. Interest in the new Linux-based hacking tool is clearly strong, but Flipper Devices warns that it is not simply a more powerful replacement for the previously released Flipper Zero.
The company describes the Flipper One as a portable, standalone Linux computer based on the Arm architecture and designed to support a wide range of security-focused applications. The device can be used to build custom computing projects, analyze network signals, experiment with wireless communications, watch an MKV movie in a hotel room, and much more.
Flipper Devices emphasizes that the Flipper One and Flipper Zero are two fundamentally different devices designed for distinct security and hacking workflows. The Zero features a low-power microcontroller and functions as a "layer zero" networking multi-tool, offering access to various protocols and technologies including NFC, RFID, sub-GHz radio, and UART.
The Flipper One, meanwhile, is a "layer one" tool designed to work with virtually anything that offers IP connectivity. The new device supports Wi-Fi, Ethernet, 5G, and satellite communications. It also offers full support for the mainline Linux kernel and enough computing power to handle software-defined radio applications and local AI models.
The Flipper One combines a high-performance Arm system-on-chip (Rockchip RK3576) with a low-power Raspberry Pi microcontroller (RP2350). This architecture allows the device to remain operational even if users manage to completely break its embedded Linux system.
Some of the Flipper One's capabilities include a desktop mode accessible through USB-C, a network scanner and multi-tool for traffic tunneling and packet analysis, and support for custom cellular antennas and modems in underserved areas. The device also offers several expansion options through external hardware modules and an internal, high-speed M.2 expansion slot.
Flipper One pre-orders are currently priced at $399 (€364), representing a 25% discount off the estimated $550 retail price. Flipper Devices said the Kickstarter price leaves the company with no profit margin, citing the ongoing memory shortage driven by AI demand. Still, the more than €10 million raised in just 24 hours will likely keep the company happy for the time being.
Shipping is expected to begin in July 2027 in most parts of the world. However, the team warns that ongoing component and chip shortages could significantly affect production schedules and delivery dates.

articles.title: Global OLED Monitor Shipments Double YoY in 3Q26
articles.text:
Wednesday, November 18th 2026
Global OLED Monitor Shipments Double YoY in 3Q26
Global OLED monitor shipments maintained strong momentum in the third quarter of 2026, rising 13% QoQ and doubling compared with the same period in 2025, according to TrendForce's latest research. Growth was driven not only by continued product launches from major brands, which helped boost shipment volumes, but also by ample upstream panel supply. The latter has enabled second-tier and emerging brands to significantly expand their shipments.
ASUS retains top spot as MSI climbs to second place for the first time
TrendForce reports that competition in the OLED monitor market intensified in the third quarter as brands adjusted their strategies and product portfolios. Rankings shifted considerably among the second- through fifth-largest vendors, highlighting the increasingly fierce competition among brands vying for positions just below the market leader.Amid this competitive landscape, ASUS maintained its position as the world's leading OLED monitor brand, capturing a 21.7% market share. Shipments rose a steady 6% QoQ, supported by an easing of supply constraints on its key high-end 27-inch QHD 540 Hz panels. The launch of new models commemorating the brand's 20th anniversary also helped stimulate demand.
MSI climbed to second place globally for the first time, with its market share increasing 1.7 percentage points QoQ to 14.5%. Its cumulative shipments over the first three quarters were roughly on par with Samsung's. MSI's third-quarter growth was primarily driven by increased orders for its 27-inch QHD monitors ahead of the holiday shopping season, alongside the successive launches of several new models, including 27-inch QHD 320 Hz monitors.
Samsung slipped to third place, with its market share declining to 11.3%. Although the company's shipments remained relatively stable throughout the first three quarters of 2026, its share was diluted by the rapid expansion of the overall market. In response to mounting competition, Samsung plans to ramp up shipments aggressively in the fourth quarter, targeting the year-end holiday shopping season in Europe and North America. This push could help the company reclaim its position as the world's second-largest supplier.
LGE rose one position to fourth place, securing an 8.6% market share in the third quarter. Aggressive promotional campaigns for select 27-inch QHD 240 Hz models successfully stimulated demand and supported the brand's improved ranking.
Dell also moved up one position to fifth place, as its shipment performance recovered and its quarterly market share reached 8.2%. Growth was primarily fueled by continued shipment expansion of its mainstream 27-inch QHD 240 Hz models, together with accelerating shipments of a new 39-inch model introduced in the second quarter.

articles.title: Tesorai raises $5.3M to feed starving AI models with biological data and accelerate drug discovery - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Tesorai raises $5.3M to feed starving AI models with biological data and accelerate drug discovery
Drug researchers and medical laboratories generate massive volumes of biological data every single day, yet somehow the artificial intelligence models designed to speed up drug discovery are still starved of useful information.
It’s a strange paradox, but a startup called Tesorai Inc. believes it has the solution after raising $5.3 million in seed funding today.
The round was led by Perplexity Fund, IQT and South Central Ventures, and saw New Stack Ventures, NextGen Venture Partners, f7 Ventures, VitalStage Ventures and ZAKA participating. With its completion, Tesorai has now raised $8 million in total, and will use that money to try to accelerate AI-driven scientific discovery by digging deeper into existing datasets to surface the deeply buried insights that human researchers have missed.
Biological data covers a broad spectrum spanning genetic sequences to protein measurements, and metabolomic processes to cellular imaging. This information is extremely valuable to drug researchers, because it serves as the primary fuel for training advanced AI models that can predict disease pathways and identify new therapies.
AI-accelerated drug discovery is seen as one of the most promising use cases for this technology, but it hasn’t yet managed to change the world in the same way that generative AI has done. Why not? Because researchers still don’t have nearly enough of it, which limits the accuracy of the best models they’ve come up with so far.
To combat this scarcity of biological data, tech giants including OpenAI Group PBC, Google LLC’s DeepMind, Meta Platforms Inc., Isomorphic Labs Inc. and others are spending billions of dollars to generate more of it, but Tesorai’s co-founders Charlie Kim, Melissa Miao and Peter Cimermancic believe it’s also possible to do more with less.
To that end, Tesorai’s goal is to unlock the biological data that researchers already have access to. Rather than using the summarized findings available in published research papers and clinical studies, it uses AI to analyze raw spectrometry data generated by lab instruments.
Its platform consists of Tesorai Search, which rapidly ingests and analyzes terabytes of data from different sources. There’s also Tesorai Chat, which is used by scientists to ask questions of biological datasets in plain English. And there’s Tesorai Trove, a curated catalog of thousands of publicly available datasets and studies.
Those three components work together to process the raw instrument data from both new and historical lab studies and experiments, before analyzing it thoroughly to try to surface insights that were missed by their authors. By using those insights, Tesorai believes it can train more accurate AI models for drug discovery and therapy research.
“Life science R&D is accelerating and becoming increasingly autonomous, which makes it more important to extract as much insight as possible from every experiment,” Chief Scientific Officer Kim explained. “Tesorai does this for a lab’s new data and for thousands of published studies, and the gains compound as each experiment builds on the last. Ultimately, this will help the industry to develop better medicines faster.”
The startup points to a number of discoveries it has unearthed that were missed by previous studies. In one example, Tesorai reprocessed and re-crunched the data from five studies of the human brain in Alzheimer’s disease-afflicted patients. Through its analysis, it identified a key Alzheimer’s biomarker called p-tau217 that was missed in all five of the studies.
Its findings were published in JAMA Neurology in August. In another example, Tesorai illustrated how it was able to accelerate AI model training by adding protein data to a small single-cell AI model, enabling it to beat larger RNA-only models, including one with 40 times more parameters, on multiple benchmarks.
Miao, who’s Tesorai’s chief executive officer, said basically every scientific study produces much more data than what’s reported by its authors. Moreover, most of those studies are never revisited. “Our platform reclaims the value of experiments that have already been done and amplifies each new experiment with the relevant evidence that already exists,” she said.
Tesorai’s early success has paved the way for its initial traction, and it has already established partnerships with the MD Anderson Cancer Center, New York University and the Michael J. Fox Foundation. With the funds from today’s round, it will try to secure more partnerships with the life sciences industry, catalog more public studies and expand its platform to cover other molecular data beyond proteins and genomes.
Perplexity Fund General Partner Joanna Lee Shevelenko said it’s clear that AI can dramatically accelerate scientific research, and that’s why it needs as much high-quality experimental data as possible. “Tesorai is building the infrastructure to make that data usable at scale, giving scientists and AI systems a stronger foundation for advancing research,” she said.

articles.title: Nvidia GeForce driver bug reportedly hammers SSDs with up to 30GB of writes per hour
articles.text:
Nvidia GeForce driver bug reportedly hammers SSDs with up to 30GB of writes per hour — users trace massive idle wear to background service, newer driver reportedly still affected
That would use up to 5% of a typical 1TB SSD’s rated endurance each year.
Nvidia’s GeForce driver 621.14 is reportedly causing excessive background writes on idle PCs, inducing extra wear on SSDs. One user measured about 3GB an hour on the susceptible driver, and another mentioned estimated up to 30GB/hour on the newer 621.24. This follows a similar-looking bug from AMD’s video driver discovered last month.
The bug is described by user Andergraude in an Nvidia forum post as “new in 621.14,” which came out on Nov. 4, who says it operates by “continuously [rewriting] the binary log file” with “real writes” to the drive. The writes are coming from the NVDisplay.Container.exe process, or the “NVIDIA Display Container LS” service, which logs to the nvlog.nvlgstg file. This background service is necessary for running the Nvidia Control Panel and App. It’s not clear what’s written in the log, and not every system is necessarily impacted.
The “real writes” point comes from the fact that a per-process write counter is not the same as writes reaching the drive. The measurements came from Windows Resource Monitor, Windows performance counters, and CrystalDiskInfo. The Data Units Written counter matched Windows’ reporting. This test showed 515MB of process I/O coming with 270MB of total writes to the C: drive over five minutes. That works out to roughly 3GB per hour, in line with the user’s own estimate.
Worse, “the write volume increases as the file grows.” Stopping the service and deleting the log can temporarily reduce the writes. With the previous driver version 621.01, the writes totaled less than 2MB per five minutes, and a second user in the thread confirmed that a rollback helps.
Mitigation attempts, such as three clean reinstalls with the help of DDU from that second user, did not fix the problem. The writing process also impacted gaming and video performance, potentially causing hitching, which suggests it gets worse under load.
Another user, AyzekUorren, in a separate thread about driver 621.24, which came out Nov. 12, says that it could get up to “about 30gb per 1h” or even “70gb or even more” with longer sessions. This is even with telemetry disabled in the Nvidia App. Noted is that every Alt+Tab added 500MB to 1GB of writes, at least for this user.
In AMD’s case, it was the External Events Utility, or atieclxx.exe, that exhibited constant writes on an idle PC. In that case, the AMD utility was reportedly copying its own executable every second. To put the impact into context, the AMD bug had rates reported between 0.3 and 5MB/s while total drive writes in the 621.14 test measured around 0.9MB/s.
Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
The Nvidia numbers are somewhat alarming, given that a typical 1TB SSD is rated for 600TB of writes over a standard five-year warranty. Even at 270MB per five minutes, this could be about 28TB per year — for a never-sleeping PC — which is reaching toward 5% of the drive’s rated endurance, although the writes include everything the system is writing and realistic uptime will be less. However, at the higher end — 30GB per hour, at eight hours a day — one could see 15% of drive endurance worn every year for nothing.
This doesn’t make it a drive killer, but given how much users value drive endurance, especially with SSD prices as they are, avoiding unnecessary writes like this is certainly a priority. To see if you’re affected, check Resource Monitor and look for the telltale NVDisplay.Container.exe and the nvlog.nvlgstg file in the list. You can also check the SMART Data Units Written value with CrystalDiskInfo or equivalent, such as your drive’s SSD toolbox.
At this time, no fix or hotfix has been announced, and the best workaround is to do a rollback. A similar issue in the past, fixed with driver update 471.96 back in 2021, was covered by Nvidia’s release notes. As it stands, Nvidia has “N/A” for 621.24’s Open Issues, and the company has not acknowledged the bug. For the AMD bug, the driver wasn't fixed for over three weeks (and came as an optional update).
