articles.title: Jensen Huang puede proponer dos directores en Nvidia aunque renunció, porque conserva más de 3% de las acciones
articles.text:
Jensen Huang, que renunció como director ejecutivo de Nvidia el 12 de noviembre de 2026, tiene derecho a proponer dos candidatos al directorio de la empresa, según informó Reuters con base en documentos corporativos y datos de LSEG, una proveedora de información financiera. El derecho depende de su participación accionaria, de cerca de 3,5 por ciento.
Las reglas de Nvidia permiten que los accionistas o grupos con más de 3% del poder de voto durante al menos tres años propongan directores, cuyos nombres deben figurar en los materiales de la votación anual. Huang y entidades vinculadas superan ese umbral hace más de tres años.
Los candidatos tendrían que calificar como independientes y recibir el voto de los accionistas. Nvidia puede excluir a un postulante si este incumplió los estatutos de la empresa. Aunque no se ha podido establecer si la conducta de Huang infringió esas normas. La junta anual de accionistas suele celebrarse en junio, según el despacho.
El directorio descartó su regreso como director ejecutivo
El martes 17 de noviembre de 2026, el presidente del directorio, Harvey Jones, abrió la conferencia sobre resultados con una frase clara. “El directorio aceptó por unanimidad su renuncia y no tiene la intención de reinstalar a Jensen como director ejecutivo”, dijo, y agregó que no responderían preguntas sobre las circunstancias de la renuncia ni sobre la investigación.
Horas antes, Huang había difundido su primer comunicado desde que dejó el cargo. “Creé problemas para el directorio que lamento profundamente”. Dijo que se sentiría “honrado” de volver si el directorio lo considera lo mejor para accionistas, empleados, la empresa y Estados Unidos.
Huang renunció tras la revelación de una actuación personal que, según Nvidia, contradice su código de conducta. TechCrunch informó que entre las relaciones extramatrimoniales figura la de Alice Huang, sin parentesco con él y exejecutiva de la empresa Megaspeed, a quien funcionarios estadounidenses no identificados sospechan agente de China. Beijing lo calificó de “completamente infundado” y Megaspeed negó irregularidades.
Trump, Musk y una petición pidieron su regreso
El lunes 16 de noviembre de 2026, el presidente Donald Trump dijo que “ciertamente” no le molestaría ver a Huang de vuelta, según Reuters. Una petición para reponerlo sumaba más de 177.000 firmas ese día, entre ellas las de Elon Musk y del director ejecutivo de Epic Games, Tim Sweeney. Al Jazeera la ubicó cerca de las 200.000.
Charles Elson, exprofesor de gobierno corporativo de la Universidad de Delaware, dijo a Axios que reponerlo casi llegaría al absurdo. “Hay una muy buena razón por la que se fue, y esa razón no ha cambiado”, afirmó.
La directora financiera, Colette Kress, dirige la empresa de forma interina. Jones informó que la firma de búsqueda de ejecutivos Heidrick & Struggles evaluará candidatos internos y externos, y que el directorio formó un comité de seguridad nacional y controles de exportación.
La conferencia coincidió con resultados sólidos: Nvidia facturó USD 115.800 millones en el trimestre cerrado el 25 de octubre, un 103% más que un año antes, y proyectó USD 130.000 millones para el siguiente. El analista Jay Goldberg, de Seaport Research Partners, dijo a Al Jazeera que el regreso de Huang es “improbable pero posible”.
La salida de Huang abrió una tensión entre el peso de un fundador, las reglas de gobierno corporativo y la responsabilidad del directorio ante los accionistas. Su participación accionaria le conserva una vía formal para influir en la composición de la junta, aunque no garantiza un regreso al puesto ejecutivo.
Con resultados financieros al alza y una sucesión en marcha, Nvidia enfrenta el reto de separar la continuidad de su negocio de la figura que lideró su expansión tecnológica.

articles.title: European game dev unions publish a manifesto calling on studios to ditch generative AI
articles.text:
What just happened? Use of generative AI in game development is now widespread and controversial. As tech giants promote the productivity gains the technology supposedly offers, developers and users debate its usefulness, impact, and ethics. Several European game development unions have recently come out flatly against GenAI, summarizing every major criticism of the technology, including its environmental impact, accusations of stolen material, its cognitive effects on workers and employers, and more.
Unions representing game developers in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain, and Italy recently published a lengthy manifesto calling on companies to abandon or at least carefully monitor GenAI use. The document cites numerous studies on the technology's negative impacts in different sectors of the workforce.
Interestingly, the manifesto's section on using human input to train AI without consent is its smallest, but the unions stress that this doesn't diminish its importance. The AI industry has previously admitted that the technology can't exist without copyright infringement, and a Microsoft executive even called it the largest labor theft in human history.
The manifesto also alleges that many workers are being implicitly and explicitly forced to use GenAI, which shouldn't be necessary if it always saves time and increases productivity. Instead, the unions cite studies saying that the technology makes tasks more monotonous and causes skills to atrophy.
Bosses can also experience cognitive surrender from excessive GenAI use, which impacts how they interact with employees. Furthermore, workers claim that GenAI often performs tasks traditionally assigned to junior employees, eliminating job openings and stemming the flow of new talent.
The unions accuse GenAI vendors of obfuscating the technology's costs to employers in a scheme to eventually monopolize knowledge and skills. As workers train AI that starts out cheap, employers might find themselves locked into more expensive contracts after the AI replaces workers and captures institutional knowledge previously held by workers.
In conclusion, the manifesto primarily recommends avoiding GenAI. However, if a developer chooses to use it or finds no alternative, it should work with employees to define clear regulations.
The worldwide percentage of developers using GenAI remains unclear, but the available information indicates it is high. For example, 86% of respondents to a Japanese survey in September admitted to using the technology in some capacity. An earlier survey indicated that more than half of developers believe GenAI is harming the industry.
GenAI use already sparked strong union action in 2024, when the Screen Actors Guild fought for clear guidelines regarding the technology. The dispute also involved video game voice actors, with dozens of titles eventually accepting AI usage agreements.

articles.title: Gemini Notebook permite criar sites interativos a partir das suas anotações • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Gemini Notebook permite criar sites interativos a partir das suas anotações
Novo recurso fica disponível com prompt simples e promete facilitar a vida de estudantes e professores. Apenas usuários maiores de 18 anos podem acessar.
O Gemini Notebook agora permite criar sites interativos com prompt simples diretamente na plataforma de IA. Os links podem ser abertos no navegador e também compartilhados com colegas e alunos, por exemplo. A ferramenta promete facilitar estudos na escola ou universidade, além de ajudar na criação de materiais para estudo.
Para criar, basta inserir “Crie um site…” na caixa de texto, incluindo direcionamentos como tamanho do conteúdo de leitura, imagens a serem adicionadas, tipo de exercícios desejados e mais. Aqui, você pode indicar ainda livros, links de referência e suas próprias anotações para gerar o conteúdo, garantindo a consulta da IA a fontes confiáveis.
O recurso já está disponível no Gemini Notebook para usuários maiores de 18 anos e assinantes do Google Workspace. A empresa promete ainda liberar a novidade no app para celular “em breve”, mas sem muitos detalhes.
A possibilidade de criar sites interativos é interessante para reforçar os estudos. Além dos resumos criados a partir de livros e notas definidos pelo próprio usuário, agora também será possível elaborar questionários com uma base mais confiável.
O prompt é bastante simples: você só precisa indicar as fontes e notas desejadas, pedir para a plataforma criar o site e indicar o estilo desejado para gerar suas questões ou resumos.
Uma vez com o site pronto, você pode pedir ajustes na própria caixa de prompts e até compartilhar com amigos. No meu caso, o site ficou separado em etapas de estudo, resumos sobre a viagem descrita no livro analisado e uma seção de quiz com perguntas de caráter linguístico, conforme o solicitado.
Também é possível utilizar chatbots como o próprio Gemini padrão, o ChatGPT ou o Claude, mas aqui os recursos funcionam tanto para limitar as consultas feitas pela IA quanto para mitigar possíveis erros. Ainda assim, vale lembrar sempre que, por ser uma inteligência artificial, há chance de erro. Portanto, cheque as informações e utilize o máximo de fontes e anotações possível para diminuir a possibilidade de alucinação.
O Gemini Notebook, atual nome do antigo NotebookLM, é um modelo de IA voltado especificamente para ajudar nos estudos. O serviço permite criar resumos detalhados, destrinchar assuntos mais aprofundados, entre outras tarefas que prometem facilitar sua vida na escola ou faculdade. Da mesma forma, é possível utilizar a plataforma para conhecer mais sobre uma área de atuação específica que você deseja aplicar no trabalho, por exemplo, além de reforçar a compreensão de textos e livros.
Outra vantagem do serviço é restringir as fontes utilizadas e, inclusive, utilizar diretamente os seus conteúdos salvos no Google Livros, além de editar PDFs. O direcionemtno pode ser dado no próprio prompt, ao lado esquerdo da tela. Também é possível criar notas, resumos e até conteúdos em áudio ou vídeo para facilitar seus estudos.

articles.title: Waymo has stopped its robotaxis from driving on the freeway—here’s why
articles.text:
Waymo is currently restricting its fleet of robotaxis to surface streets after getting into hot water with California over its cars’ driving behavior on highways. Specifically, the software tends to drive into construction zones at speed. As first reported by the San Francisco Business Times, this behavior actually drew the ire of California’s DMV earlier this month, which ordered Waymo to stop driving on Californian highways immediately and until it can convince the DMV that its cars no longer “pose an imminent hazard to public safety.”
This is not Waymo’s first run-in with this problem. In Arizona, Waymo robotaxis did not recognize ramp closure signs on six occasions in Phoenix in April and entered construction zones. A month later in California, seven Waymo robotaxis entered lanes with active construction. In June, Waymo recalled the almost 3,800 robotaxis capable of highway driving. That problem led Waymo to stick to surface streets only in California after the May incidents until late July, when the robotaxis resumed highway operations.
In early July, Waymo told the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration that it began updating the robotaxi software to a version that “improve[s] the recognition of freeway construction zones, more appropriately prioritize[s] construction zones over other freeway hazards, and reduce[s] speed when the AV detects that it may be in a construction zone.”

articles.title: LinkedIn Cuts Daily Spark Shuffle Fetch Failures from 750 to 20 with Apache Celeborn
articles.text:
LinkedIn has deployed Apache Celeborn as a shared remote shuffle platform across the majority of its Apache Spark and Apache Flink workloads, separating intermediate data storage from compute infrastructure. The deployment reduces daily shuffle fetch failures from approximately 750 to 20, lowers compute costs by 10%, and improves application runtimes by 14%, compared with its previous Magnet implementation.
Daily shuffle fetch failures decreased from approximately 750 to 20 (Source: LinkedIn Blog Post)
LinkedIn's offline data platform executes more than 300,000 Spark jobs daily across thousands of production nodes, consuming approximately 200 petabyte-hours of compute. As the company moves toward a unified Flink architecture for real-time and historical processing, large-scale backfills introduce additional shuffle workloads. Shuffle moves intermediate data between processing stages, potentially stressing networks, disks, and application runtimes.
LinkedIn previously addressed shuffle read inefficiencies with Magnet, its push-based shuffle implementation contributed to Apache Spark 3.2. Magnet aggregates shuffle blocks by reducer partition into larger files, reducing random disk reads. However, shuffle storage remained within the compute cluster, where External Shuffle Services shared CPU, memory, disk I/O, and network resources with compute workloads.
With Apache Celeborn, map tasks push intermediate data to dedicated workers, which aggregate and store partitions independently of compute executors. Reducers fetch the data directly from these workers, allowing shuffle storage to scale independently of compute and reducing dependence on executor lifecycles. Unlike Magnet, which uses merger External Shuffle Services within the Spark compute cluster, Celeborn runs as a separate shuffle service with dedicated workers and a replicated control plane. This separation reduces resource contention between compute and shuffle workloads.
Celeborn architecture at LinkedIn (Source: LinkedIn Blog Post)
Aravind Patnam, a staff software engineer at LinkedIn, explained,
Operating it reliably across thousands of nodes and hundreds of thousands of daily applications required substantial engineering beyond the upstream project.
The deployment uses a five-node Raft-based control plane distributed across availability zones, with Apache Ratis providing metadata replication, leader election, and failover. LinkedIn also introduced network-aware replication and integrated Celeborn with its host health platform to deprioritize workers approaching maintenance and exclude degraded workers. These changes contributed to a 20-fold reduction in task failures during infrastructure disruptions compared with Magnet.
LinkedIn further optimized the data plane by moving shuffle storage to NVMe SSDs, reducing overall shuffle duration by 40%. Using Zstandard compression instead of LZ4 reduced the required shuffle worker fleet by approximately 35%. The company also provisioned workers with 100 Gbps network interfaces and improved slot selection time sixfold through JVM and data-plane optimizations. Across the fleet, shuffle cost decreased by nearly 90% per task, while the proportion of executor runtime spent waiting on shuffle operations fell by approximately 10–15% from its peak.
The converged Flink platform processes hundreds of millions of events per hour in historical backfills, completing multi-day workloads in single-digit hours. Thousands of pipelines now use unified Flink computations for nearline processing and historical corrections, replacing parallel Spark implementations. LinkedIn is exploring caching and faster upstream upgrades while continuing to contribute to Celeborn.

articles.title: David Ellison says HBO will air critical Elon Musk documentary despite his $1B investment in Skydance | TechCrunch
articles.text:
Skydance CEO David Ellison says HBO will air Alex Gibney’s documentary about Elon Musk, even after news broke that the SpaceX founder had invested $1 billion in the newly formed company following its Warner Bro. Discovery and Paramount merger.
Following news of that investment, questions emerged over how Musk’s sizable stake in the company might affect Skydance’s plans to distribute a documentary that is highly critical of him.
When asked by The New York Times editor and columnist Andrew Ross Sorkin whether HBO would still distribute the documentary even with Musk’s stake in its parent company, Ellison said, “We have a pay-one deal with A24, who produced that movie. Of course, we’re going to honor the deal.”
He went on to say, “We believe in independence. We don’t believe in censorship of any kind.”
Co-CEOs David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz are tasked with bringing together two major streaming platforms, Paramount+ and HBO Max, along with a portfolio of networks, including CBS, CNN, MTV, TBS, Comedy Central, and Food Network, under a single corporate umbrella.

articles.title: Nuevo hito para la Voyager 1, el primer objeto humano a un día luz de la Tierra
articles.text:
Casi 50 años después de su lanzamiento, la Voyager 1 continúa haciendo historia. La sonda espacial ha alcanzado un nuevo hito al convertirse en el primer objetivo construido por humanos en alcanzar una distancia de un día luz de la Tierra, ha confirmado la NASA.
Hoy, miércoles 18 de noviembre de 2026, la Voyager 1 logró este registro. El mismo se produjo a las 05:16, hora del Este de Estados Unidos; es decir, a las 11:16, hora peninsular española. Esto significa que el vehículo se encuentra a unos 26.000 millones de kilómetros de nuestro planeta.
La Voyager 1 ya era el objeto humano más alejado de la Tierra, pero con este nuevo récord agiganta todavía más su leyenda. Recordemos que la sonda se lanzó en 1977 y junto con Voyager 2, su hermana gemela, ha dedicado las últimas cinco décadas no solo a estudiar el sistema solar, sino también a navegar hacia los confines de lo desconocido. En 2012 ingresó en el espacio interestelar y actualmente sigue enviando datos que captura con los instrumentos que aún tiene encendidos.
¿Pero qué implica realmente que Voyager 1 esté a un día luz de distancia de la Tierra? El Laboratorio de Propulsión a Chorro de la NASA (JPL) ha publicado un breve vídeo explicándolo de modo sencillo. La agencia espacial estadounidense indica que una partícula de luz demora 24 horas en viajar unos 26.000 millones de kilómetros, la distancia a la que hoy se encuentra la Voyager 1.
Esto quiere decir que cualquier comando que se envíe desde la Tierra demora 24 horas en llegar a la Voyager 1. En tanto que las respuestas desde la sonda hacia nuestro planeta requieren exactamente la misma cantidad de tiempo para llegar a la NASA. De modo que cualquier comunicación de ida y vuelta con la nave hoy requiere de dos días completos.
La Voyager 1 ahora está a un día luz de la Tierra
El nuevo hito de la Voyager 1 es una prueba más (como si hiciera falta) de la inmensidad del espacio. La sonda ha requerido 49 años, 2 meses y 11 días para recorrer un día luz de distancia desde la Tierra. En el caso de la Voyager 2, cuyo lanzamiento se produjo unos días antes, no se espera que esté a un día luz de distancia de nuestro planeta hasta 2035.
La Voyager 1 continúa con su trayectoria hacia la estrella Gliese 445, que está a más de 17 años luz de distancia de la Tierra. Volando a una velocidad que supera los 61.000 kilómetros por hora, la sonda podría estar relativamente cerca de dicho cuerpo (a 1,6 años luz de distancia, aproximadamente) recién dentro de 40.000 años.
Pase lo que pase con el vehículo, la Voyager 1 ha superado con creces las expectativas de la NASA y toda la comunidad científica. En los últimos años, la agencia espacial estadounidense ha logrado mantenerla con vida a pesar de su longevidad y lejanía. La sonda ha experimentado varios problemas técnicos, incluyendo interrupciones de comunicación con la Tierra, pero hasta aquí siempre se ha logrado superarlos.
Tanto la Voyager 1 como la Voyager 2 viajan equipadas con los icónicos discos de oro que sirven como un mensaje de paz para cualquier posible civilización extraterrestre que los pueda encontrar.

articles.title: Retro Kickstarter speaker can play soundtracks directly from original Game Boy cartridges — Retro Song Bird supports over 1,900, with physical controls for media
articles.text:
Retro Kickstarter speaker can play soundtracks directly from original Game Boy cartridges — Retro Song Bird supports over 1,900, with physical controls for media
Turns old Game Boy cartridges into a chiptune jukebox.
A new device on Kickstarter claims to make Game Boy cartridges relevant again by playing soundtracks from your favorite classic Nintendo games. The Retro Song Bird is a box-shaped speaker that supports Game Boy and Game Boy Color cartridges, with support for over 1,900 games. Simply inserting a cartridge into the speaker gives you access to all soundtracks and sound effects, which can be controlled using onboard physical controls including next, previous, and volume.
The Retro Song Bird also comes with a 3.5mm stereo line-out and a USB Type-C port in case you want to connect to other audio equipment. According to the developer, it offers accurate, register-level sound emulation and can be used to sample and remix music from your Game Boy cartridges. It exposes all four audio channels (two square, wave, noise) as separate USB audio streams that can be imported into a DAW. This allows you to isolate individual melodies, waveforms, and sound effects from old games to create your own melodies. There’s even support for LSDj for playing saved chiptune tracks, while two Retro Song Bird units can be synced for DJ-style performances using Game Boy cartridges instead of traditional records.
In addition to playing retro video game soundtracks, the Retro Song Bird also supports the Game Boy Camera, allowing you to use it as a webcam offering a glorious 128×112 pixels resolution and 5 frames per second speed. Other features include the ability to back up and restore save files, ROMs, flash writable carts, and export any soundtrack or sound effect as WAV onto your PC. The listing also includes other abilities, including an Alarm Mode, a record of every cartridge you've ever plugged in, an open API for developers, and over-the-air updates.
The Retro Song Bird is currently available to back on Kickstarter, with the standard model starting at $79. The introductory $59 Early Bird offer has already sold out, while the developer is also offering a two-unit bundle for $150. Shipments are expected to begin in April 2027.
The developer notes that only a handful of hand-assembled prototypes currently exist and that the hardware and design still need some refinements. The project also faces potential manufacturing challenges, including component availability, finding suitable manufacturing partners, and producing injection-molded enclosures. Like any other Kickstarter campaign, delivery timelines are subject to change, and backers should be aware that there is no guarantee the finished product will ship as planned.

articles.title: CloudBackend grabs €6.6M to turn AI-generated prototypes into productive business applications - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
CloudBackend grabs €6.6M to turn AI-generated prototypes into productive business applications
Just about anyone can knock up a working prototype application these days using artificial intelligence coding tools, but what happens when they want to turn that app into a viable business?
That’s the question that Swedish AI infrastructure startup CloudBackend AB thinks it can answer after raising €6.6 million ($7.25 million) in seed funding today. Leading the round was the family office of Carl-Henric Svanberg, formerly chairman of the Swedish government’s AI Commission, with participation from M2 Asset Management.
CloudBackend says it’s targeting the parts of application development that can’t be whipped up in seconds by generative AI tools. While vibe coding platforms such as Anthropic PBC’s Claude and OpenAI Group PBC’s Codex can deliver a working application, they can’t go the whole hog and turn it into a revenue-generating product.
The problem is that although vibe coding tools are great at generating application logic and user interfaces, they don’t know much about building the backend infrastructure. There’s a lot to do, because applications can’t just function – they also need robust security in place, the ability to scale up to thousands of users, they need to provide customer support, and they must work reliably in every situation. There’s also the question of how to monetize the app, getting insights from users, pricing considerations and marketing operations.
All of this is what CloudBackend’s Operations Platform is designed to handle, founder and Chief Executive Daniel Arthursson (pictured) told SiliconANGLE. It provides all of the backend infrastructure needed to turn any AI-generated prototype into a viable and profitable business within a single, accessible environment. “AI has made it much easier to build the first version of an application, but the challenge comes when customers sign in and expect the service to be secure, reliable and available every day,” he said.
Arthursson said the Operations Platform has five key components, including the extremely flexible Singularity Database that unifies relational data, object storage, caching and user files within a single platform. It offers robust identity and access controls integrated at the data layer, so users don’t have to stitch together multiple services to secure their application data.
Another key component of CloudBackend’s platform is “Build,” which allows skilled developers to create application frontends using declarative XML or native software development kits and then bind them to live data and deploy them in cloud environments without a continuous integration and deployment pipeline. Then there’s “Run,” which provides built-in tools for user subscriptions, customer relationship management and support, and revenue tracking within a single interface.
CloudBackend also offers collaboration tools that allow apps to keep their user’s data in perfect synchronization so multiple users can work together on projects. Finally, there’s a data sovereignty component that’s aimed at European organizations that must ensure all customer data is stored in Europe.
“We’re building the AI cloud infrastructure that helps creators make the leap from prototype to production without extensive technical knowledge,” Arthursson said. “It’s a new type of infrastructure designed for applications built with AI.”
CloudBackend’s infrastructure has been up and running with early access users so far, and with today’s funding round under its belt, it’s now planning to open it up to more users, with a free developer beta slated to open Nov. 24. The money from today’s round will also help CloudBackend to build deeper integrations with select vibe coding tools and large language models, Arthursson said.
The long-term vision, according to Arthursson, is to make the backend infrastructure and business operations as simple as the generative AI coding process has become.
Hans Lindroth, CEO of the Svanberg Family Office, said there will be lot of demand for what CloudBackend is offering, because it makes generative AI coding tools much more attractive when anyone can use them to start a business.
“AI makes it easier to build applications, but turning them into production-grade solutions for businesses is a different challenge,” he said. “We see a growing need for infrastructure that helps businesses to operate securely, serve customers reliably and expand their offerings. Daniel and his team have the experience and expertise to address that need and that’s why we chose to lead this round.”

articles.title: 'All I need is a dimly-lit room, some tappy glass jars and crunchy paper': Shure's new MV360 Spatial Audio mic has me thinking I need to give up the day job and start an ASMR channel
articles.text:
Shure's affordable new MV360 Spatial Audio mic has got me thinking I need to give up the day job and start an ASMR channel
In the age of AI, it's got to be a viable career choice…
- Shure just announced its new MV360 Spatial Audio Microphone
- It's designed to make 360 capture 'accessible to creators at every level'
- It has 4 additional capture modes: immersive binaural, stereo, mono, auto tracking
Ever fancied quitting the day job and starting your own ASMR channel (you know, those YouTube videos that feature sleep and relaxation routines with tappy sounds and a whispered voice here and there)? With job security very much on our radar in the age of AI, it's not a bad thought, is it?
Fortunately, Shure (which has plenty of form when it comes to small, quality mics) has just the thing. The company has announced the MV360 Spatial Audio Microphone, a $349 / £339 / €389 USB-C mic (so, around AU$635) that promises to "make immersive audio capture accessible to creators at every level".
So, even newbies? Yes, Shure is, well, sure of it. It's available from today, November 18, and alongside the MV360's truly pocketable build (it's about the size and weight of one of those large, retractible makeup brushes but in a cool, metallic cylinder) and 360-degree spatial audio capture, it comes with four additional ready-to-use Capture Modes: immersive binaural, stereo, mono, and auto tracking.
The idea with the mic and its accompanying software is to capture more than sound. Shure's engineering team showed me a few videos during an early briefing for the product, and the idea is to capture a sense of place — think rustling tree leaves overhead, a babbling brook down by your left ankle, birds chirping on a picnic table to your right.
And if used in podcasts (TechRadar has one, if you've yet to discover it) listeners should feel closer to a conversation — or more immersed in the ASMR scene you might create once you're free of work and have the time.
How to do it? You set up your preferences in the free Shure MOTIV apps, then record any of MV360’s Capture Modes directly to USB-C mobile devices, computers, and compatible third-party apps, all without reopening MOTIV.
As you can probably guess, I am a writer and reviewer rather than a content creator, but having seen it happen during Shure's briefing, the company has made it a simple experience. For 360 spatial audio capture, for instance, you can record directly into the MOTIV apps or a DAW of your choice, and add advanced applications such as VR in post-production.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
Eduardo Valdes, Associate Vice President of Global Marketing and Product Management at Shure, told us: “Until now, capturing that sense of presence has required expensive equipment, technical expertise and time that many creators simply don’t have.
"The MV360 changes that. It gives creators an easy way to bring listeners closer to the conversation, the performance or the world around them, while giving experienced professionals the control they need to shape every detail.”
Spatial audio capture simplified
So, the MV360 captures your high-definition audio and then connects to a phone, tablet, or computer over USB-C. So far, so good. Once connected, you can record Capture Modes directly to any device and third-party apps, or use the free MOTIV apps to record full 360 spatial audio.
On those Capture Modes, you've got: Mono (capture simple directional mono audio with three selectable polar patterns: cardioid, supercardioid and bi-directional); Stereo (control natural width and separation for music, environments, and everyday recording); Immersive Binaural (immersive sound with more spatial cues than stereo, which Shure says is "perfectly suited for playback on headphones"); and Auto Tracking (for keeping podcasts, interviews and moving subjects in focus as a virtual mic steers toward the loudest sound source).
Each Capture Mode records a ready-to-use two-channel file direct to compatible apps and devices, i.e., no post-production required. And behind these, Shure’s proprietary acoustic array captures audio at up to 32-bit float/96 kHz — but you can fine-tune gain, EQ, compression, limiting, and denoising in the MOTIV apps, and monitor it all directly through the microphone’s 3.5 mm output.
For creators who choose full 360 spatial audio, the MV360 captures the complete sound field in Ambisonic B-format (Ambix), preserving greater flexibility after recording. Using MOTIV Mix, the MOTIV Audio mobile app, or the Shure Virtual Mic Editor plugin within their preferred editing tools, creators can position, steer, and mix virtual microphones, then configure the same recording for mono, stereo, binaural, 5.1, or up to 7.1.4. This supports everything from simple recordings to advanced immersive projects for Atmos, surround sound mixing, virtual reality, game development, and 360-degree video.
I have given this mic to our storied video team — makers of the aforementioned TechRadar podcast — and they are busily planning an episode involving (and I quote): "Clicky-clacky nice-sounding gadgets, thocky keyboards, mice, retro gadgets with nice startup chimes, that kind of thing" with the Shure MV360. Watch this space…
One more thing…
Shure is looking to the future, even as it releases an all-new mic. The company has clearly noticed that video journalism is the cat's miaow — and to that end, there's something new coming.
For field recordists, videographers and VR storytellers who want to pair immersive audio with mirrorless cameras, DSLRs, action cameras, or 360 camera systems — or use the microphone as a standalone field recorder — Shure says the MV360+ (note the 'plus' on the end there) will add onboard 32-bit float recording to a microSD card, an internal rechargeable battery, and wireless control from a mobile phone.
I wasn't shown this step-up model at the briefing I attended, but Shure tells me that from up to approximately 100 feet away, creators can start and stop onboard recording and configure the MV360+ from a phone.
Pricing and availability? Let's get into it. The Shure MV360 Spatial Audio Microphone Kit is available today for $349 / £339 / €389 (so around AU$635), and includes a compact USB-C microphone, tripod, cold shoe mic clip, 5/8-inch mic clip, phone clamp, two USB-C cables, carrying case and foam windscreen (see accompanying images — I have to say that this feels like a lot of kit for the money). 
The step-up Shure MV360+ Spatial Audio Microphone will be arriving in early 2027 for $449 / £439 / €499 (so around AU$735) and will include the MV360+ microphone, tripod, 5/8-inch mic clip, cold shoe mic clip, carrying case, USB-C cable, foam windscreen, and 3.5 mm audio cable.
So now all you need is your dimly-lit room, your calmest, friendliest whisper-voice, a jar to tap your nails on, and some crunchy paper. In the meantime, do look out for our early thoughts on the MV360 in action, on the pod…

articles.title: Seit Windows 2000: Das Betriebssystem trackt jede App, die du jemals geöffnet hast – so verhinderst du das
articles.text:
Seit Windows 2000: Das Betriebssystem trackt jede App, die du jemals geöffnet hast – so verhinderst du das
Seit Monaten sehnen sich Nutzer:innen von Windows 11 nach mehr Privatsphäre bei der Nutzung des Betriebssystems. Das liegt daran, dass sich Microsoft gerade mit den KI-Features von Windows den Ruf verschafft hat, etwas zu tief in die Daten und Aktivitäten der User:innen einzugreifen. Doch seit geraumer Zeit gelobt Microsoft Besserung und nimmt auch Änderungen für mehr Privatsphäre in Windows 11 vor.
Warum Windows deine App-Aktivitäten trackt
Was viele Windows-11-Nutzer:innen nicht wissen: Es gibt schon seit Jahrzehnten ein Feature im Betriebssystem, das der Privatsphäre einen geringfügigen Strich durch die Rechnung macht. Denn mit Windows 2000 hat Microsoft eine Funktion eingeführt, die sämtliche installierten, gestarteten und deinstallierten Apps in einer Liste aufzeichnet. Obwohl Windows 2000 schon lange nicht mehr aktuell ist, versteckt sich die Funktion auch heute noch im modernen Betriebssystem.
Wie XDA Developers berichtet, handelt es sich dabei um eine Startmenüfunktion, die Microsoft seinerzeit als „personalisierte Menüs“ bezeichnete. Ziel war es, die meistgenutzten Apps im Startmenü immer als Erstes anzuzeigen. Um das umzusetzen, muss Windows natürlich die Apps und deren Starts zählen. Diese Zählung wurde in der Registrierung unter einem Schlüssel namens „UserAssist“ vorgenommen. Und der existiert auch heute noch und verrichtet weiter seine Arbeit.
In einem Test hat sich XDA Developers in die Aufzeichnungen von „UserAssist“ gestürzt und dabei interessante Informationen zusammengetragen. Standardmäßig zeigt der Registry-Eintrag nur codierte Einträge an. Erst mit dem kostenlosen Programm „UserAssistView“ werden die kryptischen Einträge in echte App-Namen verwandelt. Das Ergebnis: Seit Mai 2022 hatte der Windows-PC mehr als 325 Einträge in der Liste verzeichnet.
Die Liste zeigt nicht nur die Gesamtzahl der App-Starts aller Anwendungen, sondern auch, wann sie installiert und sogar deinstalliert wurden. Wird eine App vom PC entfernt, verschwindet sie also nicht einfach aus der Liste. Wir haben die App ebenfalls ausprobiert und zahlreiche Einträge in der Liste entdeckt. Darunter etwa, wie wir den Vivaldi-Browser gestartet haben, inklusive genauem Datum und Uhrzeit. Dazu kamen sämtliche Starts von Games, Tools und Co.
So schaltest du das App-Tracking ab
Wer das alte Feature abschalten will, kann das glücklicherweise mit wenigen Klicks erledigen. Microsoft bietet eine entsprechende Option in den Einstellungen von Windows 11, die allerdings etwas versteckt ist. Öffne dazu die Einstellungen und den Bereich „Datenschutz und Sicherheit“. Dort findest du das Menü für „Empfehlungen und Angebote“. Öffnest du es, kannst du dort den Schieberegler bei „Start- und Suchergebnisse verbessern“ deaktivieren.
Einmal abgeschaltet, verschwindet damit auch die zuvor aufgezeichnete Liste an Apps. Erst wenn das Feature wieder aktiviert wird, beginnt Windows 11 erneut mit dem Tracking. Wie XDA Developers berichtet, tauchen dabei aber auch Anwendungen in der Liste auf, die nach der erneuten Aktivierung und auch vor der Abschaltung noch nie gestartet wurden. Woran das liegt, ist allerdings nicht bekannt.

articles.title: ABAN partners African Angel Academy to boost angel investor capacity - Disrupt Africa
articles.text:
The African Business Angel Network (ABAN) has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the African Angel Academy (AAA) to expand access to practical investment education for angel investors across the continent.
Established in 2015, ABAN is the largest pan-African organisation of angel investors on the continent. Active in 38 African countries and the diaspora, it brings together over 75 member networks and more than 5,000 angel investors committed to fuelling early-stage innovation.
The AAA, meanwhile, is an African-led initiative that trains and supports angel investors and early-stage investors to actualise their investment objectives through training, coaching, networking, and showcasing of investment opportunities.
The partnership between the two organisations will give ABAN’s investor community access to structured learning, practical tools and peer connections designed to support more informed participation in early-stage investing.
To put the partnership into action, the AAA is launching the Angel Investing Learning Programme, a five-week programme open exclusively to members of the ABAN community. Running from February 8 to March 10, 2027, it covers four core modules from the AAA curriculum – due diligence, deal structuring, valuations and negotiations – combining expert instruction with practical exercises and peer learning.
Participants who complete the programme will receive an AAA certificate and retain access to course materials for two months. ABAN members enrolling in groups of at least 20 will get a 20 per cent discount on the US$350 programme fee.
“Building a stronger angel investment ecosystem requires more than increasing the number of investors. It requires giving investors the knowledge, tools, and networks to make informed investment decisions and support the companies they back,” said Fadilah Tchoumba, CEO of ABAN.
“Africa’s early-stage ecosystem grows when more Africans are ready to invest, and ready to invest well,” said Fiona Kiruja, CEO of the African Angel Academy. “That means more Africans backing the founders building on this continent, more professionals and operators finding their entry point into early-stage investing, and more high-net-worth individuals mobilising the capital that already exists here.”
Applications for the programme are open here.

articles.title: Google Wallet arrive sur l’iPhone, mais pas pour tout le monde
articles.text:
C’est désormais officiel : Google Wallet est disponible sur iOS. Le portefeuille numérique de Google, bien connu des utilisateurs sous Android, dispose donc désormais d’une application sur l’iPhone.
Comme le propose déjà l’appli native Apple Cartes, Google Wallet doit permettre aux possesseurs de l’iPhone d’accéder à leurs cartes de fidélités, titres de transport et autres reçus. Synchronisée automatiquement avec Gmail et les autres services Google, Google Wallet est capable d’importer automatiquement vos informations ou encore de suivre vos colis.
Pas de paiement sans contact et une disponibilité limitée
Concrètement, la version iOS de Google Wallet vous permettra de numériser vos cartes physiques et autres documents en utilisant l’appareil photo de l’iPhone. Vous pourrez y gérer les cartes bancaires associées à votre compte Google pour payer plus rapidement vos achats en ligne depuis Chrome, les services Google ainsi que sur les sites acceptant Google Pay.
L’appli iOS de Google Wallet s’architecture autour de deux onglets, une page d’accueil regroupant les livraisons à venir, les cartes d’embarquement et les cartes de fidélité, et un onglet dédié aux transactions et aux passes qui consigne l’historique de vos transactions récentes, ainsi que les cartes enregistrées et les passes épinglés.
Ceci étant, Google Wallet sur l’iPhone est amputée d’une fonctionnalité majeure. Restrictions d’iOS oblige, Google n’a pas pu y intégrer Tap to Pay, son système de paiement sans contact. À moins que Google et Apple ne conviennent d’un accord, les utilisateurs d’iPhone devront donc toujours s’en remettre à Apple Pay pour régler leurs achats sans contact avec leur iPhone dans les boutiques physiques.
Autre limitation, et pas des moindres, l’appli iOS de Google Wallet n’est pour l’instant disponible qu’aux États-Unis. Google n’a pour l’heure donné aucune indication quant à une éventuelle disponibilité de son application sur l’iPhone ailleurs dans le monde.

Processeur bridé pour limiter les coups de chaud.
Ultra grand-angle en retrait.
5 ans de mises à jour majeures (on espérait mieux).
Le Xiaomi 17T Pro monte en gamme, mais aussi en prix. Il séduit par son écran Amoled très lumineux, ses performances solides, son design soigné, son triple module photo polyvalent et surtout son énorme batterie de 7000 mAh, véritable atout au quotidien malgré une recharge logiquement plus longue. Reste un terminal imposant, pollué par trop d’apps préinstallées et gratifié d’un support logiciel étendu, sans pour autant être le meilleur. Lancé sous les 1000 €, il n’est plus l’affaire imbattable d’hier, mais demeure un modèle très complet pour qui cherche puissance, endurance et grand écran sans viser l’Ultra.

articles.title: From Deepfakes to Helpdesk Impersonation: Why Stronger Verification Matters
articles.text:
In 2024, an employee at engineering firm Arup was tricked into transferring $25 million after attending a fake video conference featuring deepfake versions of their colleagues.
A year later, Marks & Spencer (M&S) suffered a major cyberattack after attackers used social engineering to gain access through a third-party helpdesk.
More recently, attackers have impersonated IT support staff to convince employees to hand over remote access to their devices.
While the tactics differ, these incidents raise an important question for IT and security teams: how can organizations be confident that someone requesting access or authorizing a sensitive action is who they claim to be?
We examine these attacks and explore how stronger identity verification and more secure workflows can help organizations defend against similar threats.
The Arup Deepfake Fraud
A finance employee at engineering firm Arup's Hong Kong office received an email in January 2024 that appeared to come from the company's UK-based CFO, requesting a series of transactions. Initially suspicious, the employee was convinced the request was genuine after joining a video conference featuring what appeared to be the CFO and several colleagues.
However, the meeting was a deepfake. According to Hong Kong police, the attackers had used publicly available video and audio to create a convincing pre-recorded conference.
The employee subsequently made multiple transfers, losing approximately HK$200 million (US$25.6 million).
The M&S Cyberattack
In April 2025, British retailer Marks & Spencer (M&S) suffered a major cyberattack that disrupted operations for weeks. Online orders were suspended, contactless payments and Click & Collect services were affected, and customer data was stolen.
M&S initially estimated the incident would reduce its 2025/26 operating profit by around £300 million before mitigation.
The attack was linked to the Scattered Spider cybercriminal group, known for using social engineering to gain access to corporate networks.
M&S later confirmed that attackers had gained entry by deceiving employees at a third-party contractor, rather than exploiting a technical vulnerability in its systems.
Secure your Active Directory passwords with Specops Password Policy
Verizon’s Data Breach Investigation Report found stolen credentials are involved in 44.7% of breaches. 
Effortlessly secure Active Directory with compliant password policies, blocking 4+ billion compromised passwords, boosting security, and slashing support hassles!
Fake IT Support
Microsoft recently reported a cyberattack campaign in which threat actors impersonated IT support staff through Microsoft Teams, tricking employees into handing over remote access to their devices.
The attackers contacted employees through external Teams messages or calls, posing as internal IT personnel. Using convincing pretexts such as urgent technical issues, they persuaded employees to grant remote control through screen sharing or legitimate support tools like Quick Assist.
Once connected, the attackers used PowerShell to install malicious software, establish persistent access and gather information about the compromised network.
Microsoft also observed attempts to move laterally towards critical infrastructure, including domain controllers and certificate authorities.
The Common Thread: Trust Replacing Verification
Impersonation Exploits Familiar Trust Signals
Social engineering has long been a key technique in attackers’ arsenals. They don't need sophisticated malware or technical exploits to compromise an organization if they can convince someone that they're a trusted colleague.
Deepfake technology makes this particularly concerning, as familiar faces and voices can be recreated.
But even without AI, attackers can use convincing pretexts and trusted communication platforms to make fraudulent requests appear legitimate.
Trusted Processes Can Become Attack Vectors
Password resets and remote IT support are routine activities, but they can also give attackers opportunities to gain access if requests aren't properly verified.
Third-party providers expand the potential attack surface; organizations may have strong controls over their own systems but less visibility into how external support teams verify identities and authorize sensitive actions.
Employees Can't Be Expected to Spot Every Impersonation Attempt
Security awareness training helps employees recognize suspicious requests, but even well-trained staff can be deceived by convincing impersonation attempts.
Attackers will carry out reconnaissance beforehand to gather information that makes their social engineering attempts appear like routine requests.
Organizations need reliable verification processes that support employees when they're asked to make security-sensitive decisions, rather than leaving them to judge whether someone can be trusted.
How Can Organizations Mitigate These Risks?
Strengthen Identity Verification at the Service Desk
Rather than relying on security questions or personal information that attackers may have obtained, service desk teams should use trusted authentication methods to confirm callers' identities.
Specops Secure Service Desk helps organizations build this verification into their service desk processes. Agents can verify callers using more than 15 MFA factors, including options that don't require a phone, with integrations for existing identity platforms such as Duo and Okta.
This helps ensure that sensitive account recovery actions are supported by reliable identity checks, reducing opportunities for attackers to exploit service desk procedures.
To see it in action, explore our interactive walkthrough and discover how agents can securely verify callers before carrying out sensitive account actions.
Build Verification Into Business Workflows
As organizations introduce self-service portals, internal chatbots and automated IT processes, it's important that these systems follow the same verification standards as traditional support channels.
A password reset request made through an internal chatbot, for example, should still require strong identity verification before the request is processed.
It’s here that solutions like the Specops Authentication API can help, by allowing organizations to add secure workforce authentication and identity verification to their existing applications, automated processes and business workflows.
By integrating verification directly into these processes, organizations can apply consistent security checks at critical points without relying entirely on manual intervention.
Independently Verify Sensitive Requests
For financial transactions, privileged access, and other sensitive requests, organizations should require independent confirmation through trusted channels.
This might include contacting the requester using previously verified details or introducing additional authentication into approval workflows.
Verify IT Support Requests Before Granting Access
Where support processes are managed through internal applications or automated workflows, additional identity verification can help ensure that sensitive requests are made by authorized users.
These measures should be supported by broader security controls like phishing-resistant MFA and least-privilege access, while monitoring for suspicious account activity.
Make Strong Verification Part of Everyday Security
As social engineering tactics become more convincing, organizations can't rely on employees recognizing every fraudulent request. Strong identity verification, independent approval processes and clear security procedures can help reduce the risks.
By building these checks into service desks, applications and everyday workflows, organizations make it harder for attackers to turn a convincing impersonation into a successful compromise.

articles.title: Este pueblo madrileño ha encontrado la fórmula para dar prioridad a sus vecinos en vivienda pública: exige llevar 10 años empadronado
articles.text:
Mientras miramos con recelo el modelo de Praga, la vivienda en Madrid vive subidas históricas (el alquiler medio va camino de los 2.130 euros al mes, superando con mucho el salario base). Pues bien, esta es la nueva fórmula con la que la Comunidad de Madrid planea reservar el 75% de su parque de viviendas: que optar a un piso protegido de alquiler en Guadarrama implique haber vivido al menos diez años allí. El problema es que los vecinos que el mercado ya expulsó del pueblo no cuentan, y los que más necesitan una vivienda protegida son, justamente, los que no han podido quedarse.
La fórmula. 58 viviendas son las afectadas a este convenio de protección pública en alquiler. El lugar, Las Laderas. Son 24 pisos de dos dormitorios y 34 de tres, con un presupuesto de 14,2 millones. Seguirán como alquiler al menos otros 20 años. Los ingresos del hogar han de situarse entre 1,5 y 5 veces el IPREM.
Con un IPREM de 600 euros, eso es entre 900 y 3.000 euros al mes. Las obras ya empezaron, pero no hay fecha de adjudicación. Un 75 % de los pisos (43), se reservará a quien demuestre más de diez años de empadronamiento en Guadarrama. El resto se adjudicará siguiendo la normativa general.
No es solo Guadarrama. La Comunidad firmó el mismo día seis convenios con Guadarrama, Villa del Prado, Móstoles y Valdemoro. Es decir, este criterio se está extendiendo. Y suman 676 viviendas y 138 millones, de los que el Gobierno regional pone más de 113. En los cuatro municipios, el 75% se reserva a quien lleve diez años en el padrón local. En Guadarrama gobierna el PP gobierna en coalición con Vox, y el convenio se firma tras el rechazo al borrador regional. Esta política, por tanto, responde al motto Madrid para los madrileños de siempre.
¿Y a quién esperan? Literalmente, el argumento oficial es proteger al vecino de siempre. El alcalde, Diosdado Soto, presume de que el pueblo llevaba años sin oferta: habló de 12 en 2023 y de más de 20 en la nota de este mes. Quiere que esta promoción sea “la primera de otras”.
Sin embargo, ¿quién entra en el 75%? Porque cumple el filtro quien ya aguantó diez años en el pueblo, como decíamos, no quien se marchó porque no podía pagar, ni el joven que se emancipa, ni quien llegó hace cinco años a trabajar. Y hablamos de un salto interanual de casi el 17% en julio y subiendo. En este desplazamiento gobierna el padrón, no el trabajo.
10 años, como la nacionalidad. Es el mismo plazo que España exige para nacionalizarse por residencia. En Canarias, un decreto pide 12 años de arraigo para vivienda pública y ya tiene la primera demanda, al ser tachado de irrazonable: en una década la vida de una persona puede virar de recién emancipado a casado con hijos.
En Madrid, la propia Comunidad tanteó el mismo camino en el borrador del nuevo reglamento de vivienda protegida de marzo. Exigía 10 años de padrón en la región para comprar y 10 para alquilar. Tras el rechazo social, rebajó el alquiler a 5. Más Madrid denunció que la norma trataba como ciudadanos de segunda a cientos de miles de personas llegadas de otros países o provincias.
Paradoja comarcal. El borrador regional sigue sin aprobarse: debe pasar por la Comisión Jurídica Asesora y volver al Consejo de Gobierno. Los convenios de Guadarrama reclaman el doble de plazo que los de la Comunidad. Algo parecido ocurre con el Plan Vive, que ya subió de tres a cinco años el padrón o vínculo laboral exigible en el municipio. La vara de medir sube a medida que bajan los pisos disponibles.

articles.title: El HomeView, el nuevo dispositivo de Apple, es tan difícil de reparar que un parlante se rompió al abrirlo
articles.text:
El HomeView, el nuevo aparato de Apple para el hogar, resultó casi imposible de reparar en el desarme que publicó iFixit el 17 de noviembre. Los técnicos de esta firma de reparaciones rompieron un parlante, arrancaron conectores y forzaron la placa principal para abrir el dispositivo, que cuesta USD 299.
iFixit, que desarma productos electrónicos y publica cómo repararlos, comparó el dispositivo con los iPad y los HomePod recientes de Apple. Según el informe, esos equipos habían mejorado: el HomePod de segunda generación se abre sin destruirlo y el iPad suma manuales oficiales de reparación. El HomeView, en cambio, fue un retroceso.
Combina una pantalla de 7 pulgadas con un parlante inteligente. Apple lo presentó el 13 de octubre y lo vende desde el 13 de noviembre en Estados Unidos, el Reino Unido, Canadá, Australia, Nueva Zelanda, India y Singapur. No llegó a la Unión Europea, donde la nueva Siri con IA aún no está disponible.
Pegamento en la pantalla, los parlantes y la placa
El adhesivo de la pantalla resistió más que en cualquier producto de Apple abierto por iFixit en los últimos tiempos. La carcasa de aluminio disipaba el calor de la plancha que los técnicos usan para ablandar el pegamento, y eso alargó la espera.
Con la pantalla fuera, los conectores de los parlantes se rompieron al tirar de ellos. Según iFixit, la pieza de plástico que los sujeta quedó pegada a la placa y los cables se arrancaron. Un parlante se partió en dos aunque lo empaparon en alcohol isopropílico, y la placa principal quedó adherida a la carcasa.
Esa unión tiene una explicación de diseño: Apple convirtió la carcasa de aluminio en un disipador de calor para enfriar el chip. iFixit reconoció que la idea es acertada, pero escribió que el vínculo térmico vuelve la extracción de la placa una operación muy riesgosa.
Los técnicos encontraron además tornillos Phillips y Torx en un mismo soporte, lo que obligó a cambiar de herramienta durante todo el desmontaje. Debajo de la placa había un chip A18, 8 GB de memoria y lo que parecía un almacenamiento de 64 GB.
La base se abre mejor que la pantalla
La base del modelo de mesa se parece a la de un HomePod y salió más fácil. Un puerto USB-C modular se puede reemplazar, igual que los dos radiadores pasivos, que refuerzan los graves sin necesitar más parlantes con electricidad. El cable del altavoz de graves, en cambio, es tan corto que los técnicos dudaron de poder volver a conectarlo.
Separar la pantalla de la base es el punto más complicado. Los tornillos del pivote llevan fijador de rosca y quedan en un ángulo incómodo, y los cables pasan por dentro antes de ajustarlos en la fábrica. Para dividir las dos mitades hace falta una herramienta específica o desarmar la pantalla de forma destructiva.
iFixit también abrió la versión para pared, que Apple vende por el mismo precio. Sus piezas no son intercambiables con las del modelo de mesa: tiene una placa más grande y altavoces menores, una diferencia que Apple ya había reconocido en el lanzamiento.
El informe concluye que Apple tomó decisiones que hicieron las reparaciones “innecesaria e irrazonablemente difíciles”, y que muchas tienen sentido solo para armar el producto en la fábrica. “Nadie en Apple peleó por el día en que un HomeView se rompa”, escribió la firma especializada en reparaciones. Shahram Mokhtari, de iFixit, dijo que la empresa no tiene una escala oficial de reparabilidad para esta categoría de aparatos.

articles.title: Kotak MF, BlackRock among investors buying Rs 1,905-Cr stake in Groww
articles.text:
Kotak MF, BlackRock among investors buying Rs 1,905-Cr stake in Groww
The investors collectively purchased 8.70 crore equity shares, representing a 1.38% stake in Billionbrains Garage Ventures, the parent company of Groww, at an average price of Rs 219 apiece on Tuesday.
Domestic and global institutional investors such as Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund and BlackRock, have increased their stake in Groww by acquiring shares worth Rs 1,905 crore, according to block deal data on NSE.
The investors collectively purchased 8.70 crore equity shares, representing a 1.38% stake in Billionbrains Garage Ventures, the parent company of Groww, at an average price of Rs 219 apiece on Tuesday.
Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund (MF) led the buying spree, acquiring 2.05 crore shares or a 0.33% stake, for Rs 448.95 crore, making it the biggest buyer in the transaction.
The share purchase increased Kotak MF's stake in Groww to 2.21% from 1.89%.
BlackRock, the world's largest asset management company, was the second-largest buyer of Bengaluru-based Groww, picking up more than 1.34 crore shares for Rs 294.55 crore.
Other domestic institutional investors participating in the transaction included Tata Mutual Fund, National Pension System (NPS) Trust, and HDFC Life Insurance.
The overseas buyers included Societe Generale, BNP Paribas, Fidelity Investments, Viridian Asset Management, Susquehanna International Group, Canada's RBC Global Asset Management, Swiss banking major UBS, Morgan Stanley, and Ghisallo Capital Management.
London-based Investment management firm Redwheel, Australia's largest superannuation fund Rest Super, Teachers' Retirement System of the State of Illinois and Norway's Government Pension Fund Global were also among the buyers.
On the selling side of the deal, US-based venture capital firm Ribbit Capital, through two of its affiliates, offloaded 8.70 crore equity shares at the same price, as per the data.
Following the latest transaction, Ribbit Capital's combined stake in Groww declined to 6.91% from 8.29%.
Following the block transaction, Groww shares traded nearly 2% higher at Rs 231.30 apiece on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) on Wednesday, while benchmark equity indices were in the red.
In May, Ribbit Capital had sold more than 14.21 crore shares of Groww for Rs 2,567 crore.

articles.title: Amazon Family arrive en France : partager Prime avec un adulte de son foyer, sans supplément ni partage de mot de passe
articles.text:
Recevoir un mail qui promet des avantages Amazon Prime gratuits a souvent l’air d’un piège. Au printemps 2025, des escrocs ont ainsi envoyé de faux messages Amazon Prime contenant l’IBAN des abonnés de Free, récupérés lors d’une fuite de données. Cette fois pourtant, l’offre est bien réelle.
Amazon a lancé ce mardi 17 novembre 2026 Amazon Family en France, une fonction qui permet à un membre Prime d’inviter un second adulte de son foyer sans payer de supplément. Autrement dit, une seule personne paie l’abonnement Prime, à 6,99 euros par mois ou 69,90 euros par an, et deux adultes en profitent.
Chacun garde son propre compte, avec son historique de commandes et ses recommandations, sans partager de mot de passe. L’invité récupère la livraison Prime gratuite sur les articles éligibles, Amazon Music Prime, le jeu vidéo en streaming d’Amazon Luna et les promotions réservées aux membres, comme le Prime Day. Prime Video fait partie du lot, mais seulement avec publicités et pour le catalogue inclus dans l’abonnement.
En revanche, la liste officielle ne cite pas les offres partenaires, comme les 120 euros qu’EDF rembourse aux membres Prime qui souscrivent chez elle un contrat d’électricité.
Comment activer Amazon Family en 3 étapes
Tout se passe depuis le compte de l’abonné Prime, comme le détaille Frandroid :
- Ouvrez « Votre compte » sur Amazon.fr, puis la rubrique « Votre Amazon Family » ;
- Indiquez le nom et l’adresse e-mail de la personne ;
- L’invité recevra un mail, et devra accepter l’invitation pour accéder aussitôt aux avantages partagés.
Avant d’inviter quelqu’un, sachez que l’abonné qui envoie l’invitation, appelé administrateur Amazon Family, doit choisir un moyen de paiement à partager. L’invité peut s’en servir, mais il n’en voit que les quatre derniers chiffres, le nom du titulaire, la date d’expiration et l’adresse de facturation.
L’administrateur reçoit une notification avec le montant de chaque achat payé de cette façon. « Chaque membre d’Amazon Family reste libre de payer une commande avec le moyen de paiement partagé ou avec le sien », précise le communiqué d’Amazon.
Méfiez-vous d’une invitation qu’aucun proche ne vous aurait annoncée. En cas de doute, ne cliquez jamais sur le lien d’un mail et passez directement par votre compte Amazon ou par la page d’aide d’Amazon Family.

articles.title: GTA 6 sort demain et toujours pas de PS5 ? Amazon la propose de nouveau à 649,99€, et 6 offres gaming jusqu’à -50%
articles.text:
GTA VI sort demain sur PS5 et Xbox Series, et Amazon propose de nouveau la PS5 avec lecteur à son prix officiel. Nous avons relevé sept offres autour de la console, en séparant les vraies remises du simple retour au prix de base.
Voici sept offres Amazon relevées le 18 novembre 2026, dans l’ordre de notre liste, des deux jeux aux accessoires en passant par la console. Six sont réellement remisées, de -18 % à -50 %, tandis que la PS5 reste à son prix officiel de 649,99 €. La plus forte économie en euros est celle du PS VR2 (100 €), la plus forte en pourcentage celle d’EA SPORTS FC 27 (50 %).
- Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 (code) à 79,97 € au lieu de 99 € (-19 %)
- EA SPORTS FC 27 PS5 (disque) à 40,39 € au lieu de 79,99 € (-50 %)
- PlayStation 5 Standard 1 To à 649,99 € au prix officiel, sans remise
- Manette DualSense bicolore à 59,90 € au lieu de 74,99 € (-20 %)
- Casque PlayStation VR2 à 349 € au lieu de 449 € (-22 %)
- Écouteurs PULSE Explore à 139,99 € au lieu de 169,99 € (-18 %)
- Manette DualSense Remix Green à 64,99 € au lieu de 84,99 € (-24 %)
GTA VI : sa sortie est demain, avec 19 € de remise, à 79,97 €
GTA VI sort le 19 novembre 2026, uniquement sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, sans version PC au lancement. Amazon le propose en code de téléchargement à 79,97 €, contre 99 € de prix de référence. Le jeu n’est pas encore sorti : nous ne l’avons pas testé.
✅ Points forts
- Une remise de 19 € : 79,97 € au lieu de 99 €, le prix de référence affiché par Amazon (-19 %).
- Jouable dès la sortie : Amazon indique que le jeu devient jouable le 19 novembre.
- À savoir : il s’agit d’un code de téléchargement, sans disque, utilisable avec un compte PlayStation enregistré en France.
EA SPORTS FC 27 : -50 % sur le prix conseillé du disque PS5, à 40,39 €
Ce disque est la version PS5 d’EA SPORTS FC 27, avec Football Ultimate Team, Carrière Manager et le mode Clubs. Amazon l’affiche à 40,39 € au lieu de 79,99 € de prix conseillé, avec le badge « Offre Pré-Black Friday » jusqu’au 6 décembre. Nous ne l’avons pas testé.
✅ Points forts
- Moitié prix : 40,39 € contre 79,99 € de prix conseillé, soit 39,60 € d’économie.
- Un contenu complet : Football Ultimate Team, Carrière Manager, Clubs et le mode Rush, commenté en français ou en anglais.
- À savoir : ce disque ne fonctionne pas sur PS4, et l’offre court jusqu’au 6 décembre.
PS5 Standard : de nouveau chez Amazon, sans remise, à 649,99 €
La PS5 Standard embarque un lecteur Blu-ray 4K, un SSD de 1 To et une manette DualSense. Depuis la hausse de 100 € du 2 avril, 649,99 € est son tarif officiel en France : il n’y a donc pas de remise, seulement la console en vente chez Amazon. En juin, nous relayions l’avertissement d’un grand distributeur sur une possible pénurie de PS5 avant la sortie de GTA VI, selon TechRadar.
✅ Points forts
- Un lecteur Blu-ray 4K : la console lit les disques Blu-ray, dont ceux de votre collection PS4.
- Tout est dans la boîte : une manette DualSense, deux socles, un câble HDMI et ASTRO’s PLAYROOM préinstallé.
- À savoir : aucune remise, 649,99 € est le tarif officiel, et la livraison gratuite est annoncée pour le mercredi 25 novembre. Pour comparer, consultez notre relevé des offres PS5 avant GTA VI.
Manette DualSense bicolore : sous son plus bas des 30 derniers jours, à 59,90 €
La DualSense reprend le retour haptique, les gâchettes adaptatives et le micro intégré de la manette de la PS5, avec une batterie rechargeable, et fonctionne aussi avec un PC. Amazon la passe à 59,90 € contre 74,99 € de prix conseillé, sous le prix le plus bas des 30 derniers jours qu’il affiche (71,06 €). Nous ne l’avons pas testée.
✅ Points forts
- Sous son plus bas récent : 59,90 € alors que le prix le plus bas des 30 derniers jours affiché par Amazon était de 71,06 €.
- Les sensations de la PS5 : retour haptique, gâchettes adaptatives et micro intégré.
- À savoir : Amazon signale une offre à durée limitée, sans date de fin. Pour la batterie, consultez nos astuces pour améliorer l’autonomie de la DualSense.
PS VR2 : 100 € de remise sur un casque qui se raréfie, à 349 €
Le PS VR2 associe deux écrans OLED, le suivi du regard et des manettes Sense à retour haptique. Amazon le vend 349 € au lieu de 449 €, soit 100 € de moins, avec le badge « Offre Pré-Black Friday » jusqu’au 30 novembre. Nous ne l’avons pas testé.
✅ Points forts
- 100 € de remise : 349 € au lieu de 449 €, soit -22 %.
- Une immersion complète : deux écrans OLED, suivi du regard et manettes Sense à retour haptique.
- À savoir : Sony n’a annoncé aucun arrêt de commercialisation, mais le casque a disparu du PlayStation Direct dans plusieurs régions du monde. Pour en savoir plus, consultez notre article sur le retrait du PS VR2.
PULSE Explore : -30 €, sous leur plus bas des 30 derniers jours, à 139,99 €
Les PULSE Explore sont des écouteurs sans fil pour PS5, PlayStation Portal, PC, Mac et smartphones, avec réduction de bruit et 10 h d’autonomie selon Amazon. Ils passent à 139,99 € au lieu de 169,99 € de prix conseillé, sous leur prix le plus bas des 30 derniers jours affiché par Amazon (169,99 €). Nous ne les avons pas encore testés.
✅ Points forts
- 30 € de moins : 139,99 € contre 169,99 €, soit -18 %.
- Deux appareils en même temps : la double connectivité permet de répondre à un appel sur smartphone en Bluetooth tout en restant connecté à l’audio du jeu.
- À savoir : la note moyenne est de 3,8 sur 5 sur Amazon, pour 130 avis.
DualSense Remix Green : -20 € sur la collection HYPERPOP, à 64,99 €
Cette DualSense en coloris Remix Green appartient à la collection HYPERPOP et reprend les fonctions de la manette standard : retour haptique, gâchettes adaptatives, micro intégré, compatibilité PS5 et PC. articles.title: Free renforce sa bande passante, Orange surveille ses courbes : les box françaises face à la nuit de sortie de GTA 6 — Frandroid
articles.text:
Pour une fois, les ingénieurs réseau d’Orange ont des mots aimables pour un éditeur de jeu vidéo. L’opérateur salue le choix de Rockstar d’ouvrir le préchargement de GTA 6 à minuit le 10 novembre, neuf jours avant la sortie, plutôt qu’en début de soirée, aux heures où les box tournent déjà à plein régime. Il juge même l’éditeur plus responsable que celui de Call of Duty, dont les préchargements ouvrent à 18 h. Le trafic a doublé chez Orange sans faire tomber le moindre record.
Orange donne l’ordre de grandeur : dans la nuit du 9 au 10 novembre, son réseau a culminé à environ 19 Tbit/s, tous usages confondus, alors que son record tourne autour de 23 Tbit/s. Plus de 150 000 clients d’Orange ont déjà préchargé le jeu, selon les estimations de l’opérateur. À environ 200 Go par copie, cela représente quelque 30 pétaoctets.
Le Black Friday est lancé sur l’univers Apple. Sur Back Market, profitez de promotions sur les iPhone, MacBook, iPad, AirPods et Apple Watch. Chaque appareil est soumis à jusqu’à 100 points de contrôle qualité et est livré avec une garantie de 12 mois. De quoi profiter de performances comparables à celles d’un produit neuf.
Christian Gacon, directeur des réseaux fixes haut débit d’Orange, évoque un trafic « à peu près le double de celui qu’on avait habituellement », avec deux pics, le 10 et le 12 novembre. L’opérateur affirme avoir encaissé sans difficulté. Selon une information qui circule sur Reddit, et que l’opérateur n’a pas confirmée, Orange pourrait aussi geler son réseau les 18 et 19 novembre en suspendant les travaux non urgents. On suit la nuit en temps réel dans notre direct consacré à la sortie de GTA 6.
    Pour aller plus loin
Sortie de GTA 6 : suivez le lancement du jeu en direct
            
Free renforce, SFR et Bouygues restent discrets
Free a renforcé sa bande passante et mobilisé des équipes dédiées pour que les téléchargements simultanés ne ralentissent pas les autres abonnés, sans donner de chiffre. SFR dit ne constater aucune difficulté particulière, tandis que Bouygues Telecom profite surtout de l’occasion pour vanter les débits de ses box. Sur ce terrain, le baromètre nPerf des connexions fixes en 2025 lui donne raison, avec 491 Mbit/s en moyenne devant Free (451), Orange (425) et SFR (340). En théorie, les 212 Go descendent donc en 58 minutes chez Bouygues Telecom contre 1 h 23 chez SFR. Dans les faits, une moyenne nationale ne garantit rien chez soi, et c’est souvent le Wi-Fi ou la console qui bride le téléchargement.
Chez nos voisins, le préchargement a fait tomber des records. Au Royaume-Uni, Virgin Media O2 a dépassé le mardi 10 novembre de 3,8 % son précédent pic de trafic, établi en mai pendant la demi-finale de Ligue des champions entre Arsenal et l’Atlético de Madrid. Aux États-Unis, Comcast qualifie les 48 premières heures de préchargement de plus gros événement de l’histoire de son réseau Xfinity. Cette ruée aurait aussi pu coûter cher. Une taxe de 5,5 centimes par gigaoctet, à la charge de l’entreprise qui envoie les données, avait été votée par 11 voix contre 10 à l’Assemblée le 30 octobre : environ 11,70 euros par copie de GTA 6. Elle est tombée le 4 novembre avec le rejet de la partie recettes du budget 2027, et ne reviendrait que par le Sénat ou le gouvernement.
La Nouvelle-Zélande, premier pays servi, donne un avant-goût de minuit. Les requêtes DNS vers le domaine de téléchargement des jeux PS5, l’annuaire que consulte la console avant de contacter un serveur, y ont été multipliées par 15 au déblocage par rapport à une heure ordinaire, selon Cloudflare Radar. La saison 1 de Call of Duty plafonnait à près de quatre fois ce niveau début novembre. Ces courbes comptent les consoles qui frappent à la porte, pas les gigaoctets échangés, mais l’Europe sait à quoi s’attendre.

- Wi-Fi 7

- Sans Player TV

Que faire si on n’a rien préchargé
Ceux qui ont tout récupéré pendant la semaine n’auront qu’à débloquer leur licence à minuit. Les retardataires, eux, devront télécharger l’intégralité du jeu, y compris avec une boîte achetée en magasin, puisqu’elle ne contient qu’un code. Sur une fibre à 1 Gbit/s, il faut compter une demi-heure environ. Sur un ADSL à 10 Mbit/s, l’attente grimpe à près de deux jours. Quelques réflexes limitent la casse :
- On branche la console en Ethernet plutôt qu’en Wi-Fi.
- On laisse la PS5 en mode repos avec l’accès à Internet activé, pour que le téléchargement continue pendant la nuit.
- On évite de lancer en parallèle les mises à jour du PC ou le streaming en 4K sur la même connexion.
Les éventuels ralentissements sont à suivre dans notre suivi en direct du lancement. Rockstar a rendu aux opérateurs un service rare en étalant la ruée sur neuf jours. Si les réseaux flanchent cette nuit, les fournisseurs d’accès auront donc du mal à blâmer le jeu.

articles.title: "Aquí están los 4 trabajos que resistirán a la Inteligencia Artificial". Las predicciones de Bill Gates y el plan de Microsoft.
articles.text:
La inteligencia artificial va a cambiar bastante el mercado laboral, pero Bill Gates cree que hay terrenos en los que las personas seguirán siendo necesarias, y señala cuatro: la programación, la biología, la energía y el deporte profesional. Y es que, aunque la automatización asuma cada vez más tareas, eso no implica que los trabajadores vayan a desaparecer de todos los ámbitos.
El deporte, para las personas. Gates puso ese ejemplo en The Tonight Show en 2025. Cuando el presentador le preguntó si seguiremos necesitando a los humanos, contestó que no para la mayoría de las cosas, pero añadió que eso lo decidiremos nosotros: “Como el béisbol. No vamos a querer ver a ordenadores jugando al béisbol”. Vamos, que hay actividades cuya gracia está en que las hacen personas.
La IA como acelerador. En las otras tres áreas, la tecnología haría de acelerador más que de sustituto. Gates ha hecho múltiples declaraciones declarando que la IA ya puede generar código, pero los programadores siguen siendo necesarios para detectar y corregir errores y para hacer avanzar la propia IA. De hecho, en una entrevista con Axios Gates defendió que conviene seguir aprendiendo a programar aunque los ordenadores lo hagan muy bien, para entender lo que hay debajo.
Biología y energía. La misma recopilación le atribuye la idea de que la IA diagnostica bien enfermedades y analiza el ADN, aunque le falta la creatividad que piden la investigación biológica y los descubrimientos científicos, mientras que la energía sería un campo demasiado complejo para automatizarlo del todo.
Lo que sí se automatizará. En la misma charla con Fallon en Tonight Show, Gates avanzó que “en lo que respecta a fabricar cosas, moverlas y cultivar alimentos, con el tiempo serán problemas básicamente resueltos”, lo que afecta a la industria, la logística y la agricultura. Eso sí, también dejó claro que “habrá algunas cosas que nos reservaremos”, así que tocará decidir como sociedad qué tareas queremos seguir dejando en manos de personas.
Las salidas voluntarias de Microsoft. El debate coincide con los ajustes de plantilla de las grandes tecnológicas. Microsoft anunció el 26 de octubre de 2026 un programa de salidas voluntarias por tiempo limitado, con apoyo económico y recursos para planificar la carrera profesional, dirigido a empleados elegibles de los equipos que participan en Estados Unidos, Canadá, Reino Unido e India, pudiendo acogerse a él unos 60.000 empleados, más de una cuarta parte de la plantilla.
